title: PreCoMem: Predictive Cognitive Memory for Self-Evolving Long-Term Dialogue Agents
title_zh: PreCoMem：面向自我进化长期对话智能体的预测性认知记忆

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon dialogue agents need to keep user memories stable enough for personalization while adapting when the user genuinely changes. Existing memory systems often append every observation or overwrite old entries by heuristic rules, which makes transient noise hard to distinguish from real belief drift. We introduce PreCoMem , a memory consolidation framework inspired by predictive coding that represents memory as confidence-weighted beliefs about the user’s state. Its core signal, Effective Surprisal , combines semantic deviation and contradiction evidence, then downweights this signal when retrieval is diffuse and unreliable. According to effective surprisal, a two-threshold gate maps each turn to one of three deterministic updates: MAINTAIN reinforces supported beliefs, PROFILE stores ambiguous cues as low-confidence hypotheses, and CORRECT softly decays reliably contradicted facts. The PROFILE stage acts as an explicit waiting room, preventing premature commitment to noisy evidence. Experiments on LoCoMo, LongMemEval - S, and PersonaMem - v2 show consistent state-of-the-art accuracy; our new DiMoBench confirms that PreCoMem adapts to non-stationary belief drift without over-reacting to noise. The code is available at https://github.com/ZhongWishing/PreCoMem .
paragraphs.zh: 长程对话智能体需要让用户记忆足够稳定以支持个性化，同时在用户真正发生改变时进行适应。 现有记忆系统往往追加每一条观察，或按启发式规则覆盖旧条目，这使得瞬时噪声难以与真实的信念漂移区分开来。 我们提出 PreCoMem，一个受预测编码启发的记忆整合框架，它将记忆表示为关于用户状态的置信度加权信念。 其核心信号——有效惊异度——结合语义偏差与矛盾证据，并在检索弥散且不可靠时降低该信号的权重。 依据有效惊异度，一个双阈值门控将每一轮对话映射为三种确定性更新之一：MAINTAIN 强化获得支持的信念，PROFILE 将模糊线索存为低置信度假设，CORRECT 软性衰减被可靠证伪的事实。 PROFILE 阶段充当一个显式的等候室，防止对含噪证据的过早承诺。 在 LoCoMo、LongMemEval-S 和 PersonaMem-v2 上的实验显示出持续领先的准确率；我们新提出的 DiMoBench 证实 PreCoMem 能够适应非平稳的信念漂移，而不会对噪声过度反应。 代码可在 https://github.com/ZhongWishing/PreCoMem 获取。

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are moving from stateless responders toward long-term partners that interact with the user over hundreds or thousands of turns [ 32 , 39 , 44 ] . Such partners need more than stored transcripts; they require a user model to sustain personalized interaction [ 51 , 15 ] . To formalize the core units of this user model, we define a belief as a compact, actionable claim about the user’s preferences, goals, or life context, paired with a confidence weight that can be reinforced or revised over time. This user model underpins both agent personalization and behavioral self-correction, thereby redefining the role of long-term memory: rather than merely serving as simple context extension [ 30 , 41 ] , long-term memory enables the agent to maintain consistent behavior across sessions.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）正从无状态的应答者转变为能够与用户在数百乃至数千轮对话中进行交互的长期伙伴 [ 32 , 39 , 44 ] 。 这样的伙伴需要的不仅仅是存储的对话记录，它们还需要一个用户模型来支撑个性化交互 [ 51 , 15 ] 。 为了将这一用户模型的核心单元形式化，我们将信念定义为一个紧凑且可操作的、关于用户偏好、目标或生活情境的断言，并配以一个可随时间被强化或修正的置信度权重。 这一用户模型既是智能体个性化的基础，也是其行为自我修正的基础，从而重新定义了长期记忆的角色：长期记忆不再仅仅是简单的上下文扩展 [ 30 , 41 ] ，而是使智能体能够在多个会话之间保持行为的一致性。

paragraphs.en: The harder question is not whether information can be stored, but how it should be consolidated and revised. A practical memory consolidation mechanism must decide which observations to retain, how strongly to trust them, and when to maintain, revise, or correct stored items without explicit supervision. We refer to this as the memory stability–plasticity problem : the agent should preserve stable user traits while remaining plastic enough to adapt when those traits change [ 6 ] . Long-horizon interaction makes the problem hard for three coupled reasons. First, most turns carry little signal, while a small fraction may contain cues indicative of more persistent user states. Second, user preferences and life facts evolve over time [ 5 ] , so the system must adapt under non-stationarity and belief drift [ 49 , 7 ] . Third, corrective feedback is rarely explicit [ 14 ] , and noisy retrieval over long contexts further blurs the picture [ 48 , 25 , 4 , 43 ] . Therefore, the brittle memory update mechanism causes two opposite failures: premature correction from noise, or persistent over-reliance on outdated memories, which we call old-memory pull , a phenomenon related to loss of plasticity and retrieval interference in continual adaptation systems [ 6 , 11 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 更难的问题不是信息能否被存储，而是信息应该如何被巩固与修正。 一个实用的记忆巩固机制必须决定保留哪些观察、对它们给予多大程度的信任，以及何时在无显式监督的情况下维护、修订或纠正已存储的条目。 我们将其称为记忆稳定性—可塑性问题：智能体应保留稳定的用户特质，同时保持足够的可塑性，以便在这些特质发生变化时进行适应 [ 6 ] 。 长时程交互使这一问题变得困难，原因有三，且三者相互耦合。 首先，大多数轮次几乎不携带信号，而只有一小部分轮次可能包含指示更持久的用户状态的线索。 其次，用户偏好和生活事实会随时间演变 [ 5 ] ，因此系统必须在非平稳性和信念漂移下进行适应 [ 49 , 7 ] 。 第三，纠正性反馈很少是显式的 [ 14 ] ，而长上下文中的噪声检索进一步使情况变得模糊 [ 48 , 25 , 4 , 43 ] 。 因此，脆弱的记忆更新机制会导致两种相反的失败：因噪声而过早修正，或对过时记忆的持续过度依赖，我们将后者称为旧记忆拉力，这一现象与持续适应系统中的可塑性丧失和检索干扰相关 [ 6 , 11 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Recent memory systems have made impressive progress on retrieval and storage organization. Hierarchical and OS-style stores [ 30 , 23 , 10 ] , structured indices with timestamps or topic shards [ 34 , 40 , 21 , 38 ] , and agentic retrievers [ 45 , 46 ] all sharpen what the system can recall. However, the question of when to update is still often handled by recency overwriting, fixed-threshold importance, or one-shot append rules [ 51 , 2 ] . These triggers cannot reliably separate persistent drift from transient noise [ 11 ] , so they collapse the stability–plasticity trade-off precisely where long-horizon dialogue stresses it most. A fuller literature discussion is provided in Appendix Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 近期的记忆系统在检索与存储组织方面取得了令人瞩目的进展。 层次化与操作系统式的存储 [ 30 , 23 , 10 ]、带有时间戳或主题分片的结构化索引 [ 34 , 40 , 21 , 38 ]，以及智能体检索器 [ 45 , 46 ]，都显著提升了系统的召回能力。 然而，何时更新的问题仍然常常通过近因覆盖、固定阈值的重要性评分或一次性追加规则来处理 [ 51 , 2 ]。 这些触发机制无法可靠地区分持续性漂移与瞬时噪声 [ 11 ]，因此在长程对话压力最大的地方，它们恰恰瓦解了稳定性—可塑性的权衡。 更完整的文献讨论见附录 附录 A 。

paragraphs.en: We draw inspiration from predictive coding , which posits that learning is driven by mismatch between expectation and reality, i.e., prediction error [ 8 , 3 ] . In information theory the same quantity is called surprisal [ 19 , 29 ] . We use this view as a design principle for the update path rather than as a claim that dialogue memory is a fully specified probabilistic model. The resulting criterion is simple: events consistent with current memory should be reinforced, while surprising events may require learning or correction [ 33 , 36 ] . Crucially, surprisal must be paired with a measure of retrieval reliability , so that update decisions stay conservative when recall itself is uncertain or noisy [ 18 , 48 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们从预测编码中获得灵感，该理论认为学习是由期望与现实之间的失配即预测误差所驱动[8, 3]。 在信息论中，同样的量被称为惊异度[19, 29]。 我们将这一观点作为更新路径的设计原则，而非声称对话记忆是一个完全确定的概率模型。 由此得到的准则很简单：与当前记忆一致的事件应当被强化，而令人惊讶的事件则可能需要学习或修正[33, 36]。 至关重要的是，惊异度必须与检索可靠性的度量相结合，以便在回忆本身不确定或含噪时，更新决策保持保守[18, 48]。

sents.en: We draw inspiration from predictive coding , which posits that learning is driven by mismatch between expectation and reality, i.e., prediction error [ 8 , 3 ] .
sents.zh: 我们从预测编码中获得灵感，该理论认为学习是由期望与现实之间的失配即预测误差所驱动[8, 3]。

sents.zh: 由此得到的准则很简单：与当前记忆一致的事件应当被强化，而令人惊讶的事件则可能需要学习或修正[33, 36]。

sents.zh: 至关重要的是，惊异度必须与检索可靠性的度量相结合，以便在回忆本身不确定或含噪时，更新决策保持保守[18, 48]。

paragraphs.en: Building on this view, we propose PreCoMem (Predictive Cognitive Memory) , a self-evolving long-term memory framework for conversational LLM agents. PreCoMem operates in two active phases over a shared memory store. In memory leveraging , it retrieves confidence-weighted beliefs to condition response generation. In memory evolution , it compares new observations with recalled evidence and computes Effective Surprisal S eff S_{\mathrm{eff}} , a reliability-adjusted mismatch score. A two-threshold gate then routes each update to MAINTAIN , PROFILE , or CORRECT , corresponding to consistent, ambiguous, and reliably contradictory evidence. Figure 1 illustrates this loop on a coffee-to-tea preference shift, where a low-confidence hypothesis is gradually promoted to a fact while the contradicted old fact is softly decayed.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这一观点，我们提出了 PreCoMem（Predictive Cognitive Memory，预测性认知记忆），这是一个面向对话式大语言模型智能体的自演化长期记忆框架。 PreCoMem 在一个共享记忆库上进行两个主动阶段。 在记忆利用阶段，它检索经置信度加权的信念，以条件化响应生成。 在记忆演化阶段，它将新的观察与召回的证据进行比较，并计算有效惊讶度 S eff S_{\mathrm{eff}}，这是一个经可靠性调整的失配分数。 随后，一个双阈值门控将每次更新路由到 MAINTAIN（维持）、PROFILE（画像）或 CORRECT（修正），分别对应一致、模糊以及可靠矛盾的证据。 图 1 展示了这一循环在一个从咖啡偏好转向茶偏好的例子：一个低置信度的假设被逐渐提升为事实，同时与之矛盾的原有事实被柔性衰减。

sents.en: Figure 1 illustrates this loop on a coffee-to-tea preference shift, where a low-confidence hypothesis is gradually promoted to a fact while the contradicted old fact is softly decayed.

paragraphs.en: In summary, we (i) propose PreCoMem , a memory consolidation framework that casts long-term memory as a dynamic prediction of the user’s state; (ii) introduce a reliability-weighted surprisal signal that gates each update through MAINTAIN , PROFILE , or CORRECT ; and (iii) evaluate on LoCoMo, LongMemEval - S, PersonaMem - v2, and DiMoBench/DiMoBench - XL, controlled write-path stress tests with gradual drift and decoy retrieval. PreCoMem outperforms the strongest contemporary baselines while keeping effective memory stable across 1050 turns.
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，我们：(i) 提出 PreCoMem，一个将长期记忆建模为对用户状态的动态预测的记忆巩固框架；(ii) 引入可靠性加权的意外信号，通过 MAINTAIN、PROFILE 或 CORRECT 对每次更新进行门控；以及 (iii) 在 LoCoMo、LongMemEval-S、PersonaMem-v2 以及 DiMoBench/DiMoBench-XL 上进行评估，后者是带有渐进漂移和诱饵检索的受控写入路径压力测试。 PreCoMem 超越了当前最强的基线方法，同时在 1050 轮对话中保持有效记忆的稳定。

sents.en: In summary, we (i) propose PreCoMem , a memory consolidation framework that casts long-term memory as a dynamic prediction of the user’s state; (ii) introduce a reliability-weighted surprisal signal that gates each update through MAINTAIN , PROFILE , or CORRECT ; and (iii) evaluate on LoCoMo, LongMemEval - S, PersonaMem - v2, and DiMoBench/DiMoBench - XL, controlled write-path stress tests with gradual drift and decoy retrieval.
sents.zh: 总而言之，我们：(i) 提出 PreCoMem，一个将长期记忆建模为对用户状态的动态预测的记忆巩固框架；(ii) 引入可靠性加权的意外信号，通过 MAINTAIN、PROFILE 或 CORRECT 对每次更新进行门控；以及 (iii) 在 LoCoMo、LongMemEval-S、PersonaMem-v2 以及 DiMoBench/DiMoBench-XL 上进行评估，后者是带有渐进漂移和诱饵检索的受控写入路径压力测试。

sents.en: PreCoMem outperforms the strongest contemporary baselines while keeping effective memory stable across 1050 turns.
sents.zh: PreCoMem 超越了当前最强的基线方法，同时在 1050 轮对话中保持有效记忆的稳定。

paragraphs.en: As illustrated in Figure 2 , PreCoMem operates as a closed loop of two active phases around a shared memory store. Memory Leveraging retrieves confidence-weighted beliefs and uses them to condition response generation. Memory Evolution then revises the memory state in light of the new interaction: it computes Effective Surprisal S eff S_{\mathrm{eff}} against recalled evidence, and routes the update to one of three deterministic operators— MAINTAIN , PROFILE , or CORRECT . This read–write loop differs from prior memory systems in two ways. First, every belief item carries a continuous confidence weight w t ​ ( m ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] w_{t}(m)\!\in\![0,1] that is reinforced or softly decayed by the operators, instead of relying on discrete commit decisions such as Add / Ignore / Update in O-Mem [ 40 ] or binary expiry intervals in EverMemOS [ 10 ] . Second, PROFILE buffers ambiguous observations as low-confidence hypotheses, letting weak evidence accumulate across turns before it is committed or discarded.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 2 所示，PreCoMem 围绕一个共享记忆库以两个活跃阶段构成的闭环方式运行。 记忆利用阶段检索带有置信度加权的信念，并用它们来制约响应的生成。 记忆演化阶段随后根据新的交互来修订记忆状态：它针对召回的证据计算有效惊异度 S eff S_{\mathrm{eff}}，并将更新路由到三个确定性算子之一——MAINTAIN、PROFILE 或 CORRECT。 这一读写循环在两个方面不同于先前的记忆系统。 首先，每个信念条目都携带一个连续的置信度权重 w t ​ ( m ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] w_{t}(m)\!\in\![0,1]，由算子对其进行强化或软性衰减，而不是像 O-Mem [ 40 ] 中那样依赖 Add / Ignore / Update 这类离散提交决策，或像 EverMemOS [ 10 ] 中那样依赖二元的过期区间。 其次，PROFILE 将模糊的观测缓冲为低置信度的假设，让微弱的证据在跨轮次中逐步积累，之后再被提交或丢弃。

paragraphs.en: In implementation, each operator pairs a closed-form update rule with a fixed-prompt LLM sub-agent. The sub-agent only identifies which items are relevant and emits one bounded scalar, such as evidence_strength , severity , or initial_confidence . The deterministic layer then plugs these scalars into Equations 7 , 8 and 10 . Thus the LLM proposes local magnitudes, while the gate, confidence bounds, and closed-form w w updates control when and how memory changes accumulate. Algorithm 1 (Appendix Section B.4 ) gives the per-turn pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 在实现中，每个算子将一个闭式更新规则与一个固定提示词的 LLM 子智能体配对。 子智能体仅识别哪些条目相关，并输出一个有界标量，例如 evidence_strength、severity 或 initial_confidence。 确定性层随后将这些标量代入公式 7、8 和 10。 因此，LLM 提出局部幅度，而门控、置信界和闭式 w w 更新则控制记忆变化何时以及如何累积。 算法 1（附录 B.4 节）给出了每轮的流水线。

paragraphs.en: Items, confidence, and hypothesis lifecycle. A memory item m m has content c ⁡ ( m ) c(m) , type τ ⁡ ( m ) ∈ { FACT , HYPOTHESIS } \tau(m)\in\{\texttt{FACT},\texttt{HYPOTHESIS}\} , and retrieval metadata such as embeddings, topic labels, entities, timestamps, and source pointers into ℰ t \mathcal{E}_{t} . For belief items, w t ​ ( m ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] w_{t}(m)\in[0,1] is an operational support score. Episodic traces are fixed at w t ​ ( e ) ≡ 1 w_{t}(e)\equiv 1 and used only as provenance, not in confidence-weighted Top- K K ranking. A HYPOTHESIS is a provisional belief: it is reinforced under supporting evidence, decayed when evidence stays absent, and promoted to FACT when confidence crosses τ promote \tau_{\mathrm{promote}} . Type transitions are one-way. Contradicted facts are softly decayed by CORRECT ( Section 2.4 ) rather than demoted, yielding low-confidence “deprecated” facts that confidence-weighted retrieval naturally deprioritizes. Appendix Section C.7 confirms this retention is accuracy-neutral.
paragraphs.zh: 条目、置信度与假设生命周期。 记忆条目 m m 具有内容 c ⁡ ( m ) c(m)、类型 τ ⁡ ( m ) ∈ { FACT , HYPOTHESIS } \tau(m)\in\{\texttt{FACT},\texttt{HYPOTHESIS}\}，以及检索元数据，例如嵌入向量、主题标签、实体、时间戳，以及指向 ℰ t \mathcal{E}_{t} 的来源指针。 对于信念条目，w t ​ ( m ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] w_{t}(m)\in[0,1] 是一个操作性支持分数。 情景轨迹固定为 w t ​ ( e ) ≡ 1 w_{t}(e)\equiv 1，仅用作来源依据，不参与置信度加权的 Top- K K 排序。 HYPOTHESIS（假设）是一种临时性信念：它在得到支持性证据时被增强，在证据持续缺失时被衰减，当置信度越过 τ promote \tau_{\mathrm{promote}} 时被提升为 FACT（事实）。 类型转换是单向的。 被反驳的事实由 CORRECT（第 2.4 节）进行软衰减而非降级，从而产生低置信度的“已废弃”事实，置信度加权检索会自然地降低其优先级。 附录第 C.7 节确认这种保留方式对准确率没有影响。

paragraphs.en: Because H t H_{t} is minimized when one item dominates and maximized under near-uniform scores, ρ t \rho_{t} measures score concentration as a proxy for evidence precision. Diffuse recall (small ρ t \rho_{t} ) downweights deviation signals to avoid over-updating; concentrated recall (large ρ t \rho_{t} ) preserves them for correction. Thus the gate becomes aggressive only when recall is concentrated and the raw contradiction/deviation signal is large. Since ρ t \rho_{t} enters only multiplicatively, it can defer an update but never trigger one on its own; whether CORRECT fires still depends on the contradiction term below, and Appendix Section C.8 verifies empirically that ρ t \rho_{t} tracks evidence precision. The constant ϵ > 0 \epsilon>0 ensures numerical stability.
paragraphs.zh: 由于 H t H_{t} 在单项主导时最小、在分数接近均匀时最大，因此 ρ t \rho_{t} 度量分数集中度，作为证据精度的代理指标。 分散的召回（较小的 ρ t \rho_{t} ）会降低偏差信号的权重以避免过度更新；集中的召回（较大的 ρ t \rho_{t} ）则会保留这些信号以供修正。 因此，只有当召回集中且原始的矛盾/偏差信号较大时，该门控才会变得激进。 由于 ρ t \rho_{t} 仅以乘法方式参与，它只能推迟更新而绝不会自行触发更新；CORRECT 是否触发仍取决于下文的矛盾项，并且附录 C.8 节通过实验验证了 ρ t \rho_{t} 能跟踪证据精度。 常数 ϵ > 0 \epsilon>0 用于保证数值稳定性。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks. We evaluate on LoCoMo [ 28 ] (1,500+ questions in long contexts), LongMemEval - S [ 43 ] (500 questions covering six question types over five long-term memory abilities), and PersonaMem - v2 [ 16 ] ( 1,000 1{,}000 personas and 20,000 + 20{,}000+ implicit preferences, evaluated under both 32k and 128k contexts; Figure 3 (c)–(f)). To stress-test belief drift under sparse signals we additionally introduce DiMoBench, which adds controlled non-stationarity and decoy retrieval ( Section 3.3 ). Two third-party benchmarks, AMemGym [ 1 ] and LoCoMo - Plus [ 22 ] , are evaluated under their official protocols in Appendix Section C.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试。 我们在 LoCoMo [28]（长上下文中包含 1,500+ 1{,}500+ 个问题）、LongMemEval-S [43]（500 个问题，涵盖五种长期记忆能力下的六种问题类型）以及 PersonaMem-v2 [16]（包含 1,000 1{,}000 个人设和 20,000+ 20{,}000+ 条隐式偏好，在 32k 和 128k 两种上下文下进行评估；图 3 (c)–(f)）上进行评估。 为了在稀疏信号下对信念漂移进行压力测试，我们另外引入了 DiMoBench，它增加了受控的非平稳性和诱饵检索（第 3.3 节）。 两个第三方基准 AMemGym [1] 和 LoCoMo-Plus [22] 按照其官方协议在附录 C.1 节中进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Baselines. We compare PreCoMem against O-Mem [ 40 ] , MemoryOS [ 17 ] , MemOS [ 23 ] , Mem0 [ 2 ] , A-Mem [ 45 ] , GAM [ 46 ] , MemBox [ 38 ] , TiMem [ 21 ] , and EverMemOS [ 10 ] , each under its officially recommended configuration; we standardize the backbone LLM and embedding model across methods whenever applicable.

paragraphs.en: Evaluation protocol. We adopt the LLM-as-a-judge protocol from MemOS [ 23 ] : each answer is scored by a primary judge ( gpt-4.1-mini ) and two auxiliary gemini-2.5-flash judges (run with distinct system prompts to reduce judge-correlation) in a blinded setup, with accuracy reported as the average of the three binary judgments [ 20 , 9 , 12 , 35 , 47 ] . Appendix Section C.3 reports human–LLM agreement on LoCoMo, LongMemEval - S, and DiMoBench plus a cross-method spot-check on baseline outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 评测协议。 我们采用 MemOS [23] 的 LLM 作为裁判协议：在盲测设置下，每个答案由一名主裁判（gpt-4.1-mini）和两名辅助 gemini-2.5-flash 裁判（使用不同的系统提示词以降低裁判间相关性）进行评分，准确率报告为三个二元判断的平均值 [20, 9, 12, 35, 47]。 附录 C.3 节报告了在 LoCoMo、LongMemEval-S 和 DiMoBench 上的人类与 LLM 的一致性，以及对基线输出的跨方法抽查结果。

paragraphs.en: (1) Overall performance. PreCoMem achieves the best overall accuracy on both tabulated benchmarks. On LoCoMo it leads the strongest baseline (TiMem) by + 1.69 +1.69 with gpt-4o-mini ( 73.57 73.57 vs. 71.88 71.88 ) and + 1.02 +1.02 with gpt-4.1 ( 85.06 85.06 vs. 84.04 84.04 ); both gaps exceed the cross-seed standard deviation of either system reported in Table 1 . On LongMemEval - S it reaches 89.39 89.39 under gpt-4.1 ( + 3.23 +3.23 over EverMemOS), and the gpt-4o-mini appendix block follows the same pattern ( 84.28 84.28 , + 1.96 +1.96 ; Appendix Section C.3 ). On PersonaMem - v2 ( Figure 3 (e)–(f)) under gpt-4.1 , PreCoMem reaches 72.31 72.31 Open-Ended at 32k and 67.84 67.84 at 128k, + 3.37 +3.37 and + 2.89 +2.89 over EverMemOS. The advantage also holds on two third-party benchmarks we did not design: 0.458 0.458 Overall / 0.329 0.329 normalized Memory on AMemGym against 0.430 0.430 / 0.296 0.296 for the strongest system reported there, and 22.4 22.4 on LoCoMo - Plus against 21.05 21.05 for full-context GPT-4o (Appendix Section C.1 ). Figure 3 (a)–(d) further shows that, with the answer model held fixed, delegating memory construction to PreCoMem on a one-tier-smaller backbone still beats the larger backbone’s native memory in all twelve comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: （1）总体性能。 PreCoMem 在所列的两个基准测试上均取得了最佳的整体准确率。 在 LoCoMo 上，使用 gpt-4o-mini 时它比最强基线（TiMem）高出 +1.69（73.57 对 71.88），使用 gpt-4.1 时高出 +1.02（85.06 对 84.04）；两个差距均超过了表 1 中任一系统所报告的跨随机种子标准差。 在 LongMemEval-S 上，使用 gpt-4.1 时它达到 89.39（比 EverMemOS 高 +3.23），gpt-4o-mini 的附录部分结果呈现相同趋势（84.28，+1.96；附录 C.3 节）。 在 PersonaMem-v2（图 3(e)–(f)）上，使用 gpt-4.1 时，PreCoMem 在 32k 下达到 72.31 的开放式（Open-Ended）分数，在 128k 下达到 67.84，分别比 EverMemOS 高 +3.37 和 +2.89。 这一优势在我们未参与设计的两个第三方基准测试上同样成立：在 AMemGym 上取得 0.458 的总体分数（Overall）/ 0.329 的归一化记忆（Memory）分数，而该基准上所报告的最强系统为 0.430 / 0.296；在 LoCoMo-Plus 上取得 22.4，而全上下文 GPT-4o 为 21.05（附录 C.1 节）。 图 3(a)–(d) 进一步表明，在固定答案模型的情况下，将记忆构建委托给小一级骨干上的 PreCoMem，在全部十二组对比中仍然优于更大骨干的原生记忆。

paragraphs.en: (2) Where gains come from. On LoCoMo, the gain concentrates on the Open-Domain split (PreCoMem 48.23 48.23 under gpt-4.1 , + 1.30 +1.30 over MemOS; consistently best under gpt-4o-mini ), whose questions typically ask for a latent state that is not stated in a single turn and must be inferred from cues spread across sessions (Appendix Section C.3 ), while EverMemOS, O-Mem, and TiMem retain narrow leads on Single-Hop / Multi-Hop / Temporal under gpt-4.1 from their dedicated read-path designs. On LongMemEval - S ( gpt-4.1 ), the largest gains occur on the question types whose answers depend on updating or aggregating user-specific memory: SSP (single-session preference, + 9.24 +9.24 over O-Mem), KU (knowledge update, + 4.75 +4.75 over O-Mem; every KU question carries an old value superseded by a newer one), and MS (multi-session aggregation, + 3.55 +3.55 ). The SSA gain (assistant-side single-session information, + 3.96 +3.96 ) reflects selective memory use: the single target session lies among 48.9 48.9 sessions on average, and confidence-weighted retrieval acts as an implicit reranker. PersonaMem - v2 reproduces this pattern: PreCoMem’s lead is largest on anti-stereotypical, dynamic, and ownership-disambiguation categories that most stress write-path quality, and shrinks to under two points on stereotypical or static cues where population priors suffice. PreCoMem’s advantage is therefore strongest when answers require selective memory use, belief updating, or cross-session aggregation; a structural analysis attributes the gains to two design properties absent from contemporary baselines—continuous per-belief confidence that buffers ambiguous cues, and a confidence-weighted retrieval score that acts as an implicit reranker (Appendix Section C.10 ).
paragraphs.zh: (2) 增益来自何处。 在 LoCoMo 上，增益集中在开放域（Open-Domain）子集（在 gpt-4.1 下 PreCoMem 为 48.23，比 MemOS 高 1.30；在 gpt-4o-mini 下也持续表现最佳），该子集的问题通常要求回答一个未在单轮对话中明确陈述、而必须从散布于各会话的线索中推断出的隐含状态（附录 C.3 节）；而 EverMemOS、O-Mem 和 TiMem 凭借其专门的读取路径设计，在 gpt-4.1 下于单跳/多跳/时序（Single-Hop / Multi-Hop / Temporal）子集上仍保持微弱领先。 在 LongMemEval-S（gpt-4.1）上，最大的增益出现在答案依赖于更新或聚合用户特定记忆的问题类型上：SSP（单会话偏好，比 O-Mem 高 9.24）、KU（知识更新，比 O-Mem 高 4.75；每个 KU 问题都包含一个被更新值取代的旧值）以及 MS（多会话聚合，高 3.55）。 SSA 的增益（助手侧单会话信息，高 3.96）反映了选择性记忆的使用：单个目标会话平均分布在 48.9 个会话之中，而置信度加权的检索起到了隐式重排序器的作用。 PersonaMem-v2 复现了这一模式：PreCoMem 在反刻板印象、动态和所有权消歧等最能考验写入路径质量的类别上领先幅度最大，而在仅凭群体先验即可应对的刻板或静态线索上，领先幅度缩小到不足两个百分点。 因此，当答案需要选择性记忆使用、信念更新或跨会话聚合时，PreCoMem 的优势最为显著；结构分析将这一增益归因于当代基线方法所缺失的两个设计特性——用于缓冲模糊线索的连续逐信念置信度，以及作为隐式重排序器的置信度加权检索分数（附录 C.10 节）。

paragraphs.en: Component ablation. We ablate three core components while keeping the backbone, prompts, and hyperparameters fixed. ES removes the effective-surprisal gate by setting the gate score to 0 0 ; RR removes retrieval-reliability adjustment via ρ t ≡ 1 \rho_{t}\!\equiv\!1 ; CW removes confidence weighting globally, in retrieval and in every lifecycle test, by setting all belief weights to 1 1 . Figure 4 (a) reports LLM-judge accuracy on LoCoMo and LongMemEval - S. Removing ES causes the largest drop on LoCoMo ( → 31.46 73.57\!\to\!31.46 ; similar on LongMemEval - S): with the gate score zeroed every turn is routed to MAINTAIN , so this reinforce-only variant marks the lower bound of surprisal-gated evolution , the primary mechanism under non-stationarity, while route-matched controls that isolate the gate’s marginal value are reported in Appendix Section C.4 . Removing CW ( → 43.42 \!\to\!43.42 ) and RR ( → 56.81 \!\to\!56.81 ) also substantially reduces accuracy, with the same trend on LongMemEval - S. Letting the same LLM emit the entire write decision end-to-end instead of bounded scalars lowers accuracy by 2.75 2.75 / 3.15 3.15 points on LoCoMo / LongMemEval - S and raises the cross-seed standard deviation 20 × 20\times on LoCoMo (under gpt-4.1 ; Appendix Section C.4 ). Appendix Section C.4 shows the NLI contradiction term drives most gains.
paragraphs.zh: 组件消融。 我们在保持骨干网络、提示词和超参数固定的情况下，对三个核心组件进行消融。 ES 将门控分数设为 0 0 以移除有效惊异门控；RR 通过令 ρ t ≡ 1 \rho_{t}\!\equiv\!1 移除检索可靠性调整；CW 通过将所有信念权重设为 1 1 ，在检索以及每个生命周期测试中全局移除置信度加权。 图 4 (a) 报告了在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval - S 上的 LLM 评审准确率。 移除 ES 在 LoCoMo 上造成最大降幅（→ 31.46 73.57\!\to\!31.46；在 LongMemEval - S 上类似）：由于门控分数被置零，每一轮都被路由到 MAINTAIN，因此这种仅强化的变体标记了惊异门控演化的下界——这是非平稳条件下的主要机制——而隔离门控边际价值的路由匹配对照报告于附录 C.4 节。 移除 CW（→ 43.42 \!\to\!43.42）和 RR（→ 56.81 \!\to\!56.81）也会显著降低准确率，在 LongMemEval - S 上呈现相同趋势。 让同一个 LLM 端到端地输出完整的写入决策而非有界标量，会在 LoCoMo / LongMemEval - S 上分别降低准确率 2.75 2.75 / 3.15 3.15 分，并在 LoCoMo 上使跨种子标准差提高 20 × 20\times（在 gpt-4.1 下；附录 C.4 节）。 附录 C.4 节表明 NLI 矛盾项带来了大部分收益。

paragraphs.en: DiMoBench setup. DiMoBench (Dialogue Implicit Memory Drift Benchmark) is a controlled diagnostic setting for gradual attitude and preference drift. A user’s latent stance reverses around a change point, while keyword-matched chatter and entity confounders pollute the stream so naive retrieval and overwrite-style updates become brittle. The released suite has five independent 350 350 -turn dialogues, each driven by a distinct persona, with 200 200 QA pairs per dialogue ( 1,000 1{,}000 total; results averaged across personas); DiMoBench - XL extends this to 1050 1050 turns and three sequential drifts, with 420 QA pairs each, 2,100 in total (Appendix Sections C.6 and C.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: DiMoBench 的设置。 DiMoBench（对话隐式记忆漂移基准）是一个用于渐进式态度与偏好漂移的可控诊断环境。 用户的潜在立场在某个变化点附近发生反转，同时关键词匹配的闲聊和实体混淆因素污染对话流，使得朴素的检索和覆写式更新变得脆弱。 发布的测试套件包含五个独立的 350 轮对话，每个对话由一个独特的人物画像驱动，每个对话有 200 个问答对（共 1,000 个；结果在人物画像间取平均）；DiMoBench-XL 将其扩展到 1050 轮和三次顺序漂移，每个对话有 420 个问答对，共 2,100 个（附录 C.6 和 C.6 节）。

paragraphs.en: Operator ablation on DiMoBench. Ablating each operator individually ( Figure 4 (c)) yields qualitatively distinct failure modes: removing PROFILE caps the asymptote at 72 % 72\% (vs. 84 % 84\% ); removing CORRECT delays recovery (turn 320 320 vs. 250 250 ) and lowers the plateau to 77 % 77\% ; removing MAINTAIN fails to stabilize within the horizon ( 54 % 54\% at the end), confirming that the three operators play distinct stabilizing roles. Appendix Section C.4 provides the full analysis, and the same three qualitative signatures reproduce on the third-party AMemGym benchmark (Appendix Section C.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: DiMoBench 上的算子消融实验。 对每个算子单独消融（图 4 (c)）会产生性质不同的失败模式：移除 PROFILE 会将渐近线限制在 72%（相比 84%）；移除 CORRECT 会延迟恢复（第 320 轮相比 250 轮）并将平台期降低到 77%；移除 MAINTAIN 则无法在观察窗口内稳定（结束时为 54%），这证实了三个算子各自扮演着不同的稳定角色。 附录 C.4 节提供了完整分析，且同样的三种定性特征在第三方基准 AMemGym 上也得到了复现（附录 C.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: PreCoMem treats long-horizon conversational memory not as a transcript to be stored, but as confidence-weighted beliefs about the user’s state that must be continually checked. A reliability-adjusted surprisal signal routes each turn into MAINTAIN (reinforce supported beliefs), PROFILE (buffer ambiguous cues as low-confidence hypotheses), or CORRECT (softly decay contradicted facts). The PROFILE waiting room is the central design choice: it lets evidence accumulate before commitment, so the agent stays consistent under noise without freezing under genuine drift. Across LoCoMo, LongMemEval - S, PersonaMem - v2, and DiMoBench, this discipline yields the best overall accuracy while keeping memory bounded over a thousand turns; qualitative case studies (Appendix Section C.11 ) show calibrated recommendations beyond retrieval-only baselines. We see continuous confidence and explicit hypothesis lifecycles as a useful baseline for long-term memory systems, where what to commit matters as much as what to recall . Our evaluation covers English dialogue benchmarks; other languages and modalities are left for future work.
paragraphs.zh: PreCoMem 将长程对话记忆不视为一份需要存储的记录，而视为一组关于用户状态的、带有置信度加权且必须持续校验的信念。 一个经可靠性调整的意外度信号将每一轮对话路由至 MAINTAIN（强化有依据的信念）、PROFILE（将模糊线索缓存为低置信度假设）或 CORRECT（ softly 衰减被矛盾的事实）。 PROFILE 等候室是核心设计选择：它让证据在承诺之前得以积累，使智能体在噪声下保持一致，而在真正的偏好漂移下也不会僵化不动。 在 LoCoMo、LongMemEval-S、PersonaMem-v2 和 DiMoBench 上，这一纪律带来了最佳的整体准确率，同时在一千轮对话中保持记忆有界；定性案例研究（附录 C.11 节）展示了超越纯检索基线的、经过校准的推荐。 我们认为，连续置信度与显式假设生命周期是长期记忆系统的一个有用基线，在这样的系统中，承诺什么与回忆什么同等重要。 我们的评估覆盖英文对话基准；其他语言与模态留待未来工作。

paragraphs.en: Early work attacks the fixed context window with externalized hierarchical or virtual memory [ 51 , 30 ] . More recent systems either organize the store more aggressively or learn richer write rules. Structured organizations include interlinked note stores with associative links [ 45 ] , time-aware knowledge graphs [ 34 ] , OS-style hierarchical scheduling [ 23 , 10 ] , and dedicated memory-box layouts that segment a user’s history into typed shards [ 38 ] . Learning-based update rules optimize memory operations against downstream rewards [ 42 , 50 , 46 ] , while interpretable triggers target a single failure mode such as preference change [ 37 ] , redundancy [ 24 , 21 ] , controllable reliance [ 13 ] , or affective state [ 27 ] . A systematic gap shared by these systems is the stability–plasticity regime: append-only memories [ 45 ] treat every observation as equally valid and dilute retrieval; overwrite memories compress aggressively but lose information that later turns out to be relevant [ 2 ] ; OS-style memories [ 23 , 10 ] schedule access well but still fall back on importance heuristics for writes; and reinforcement-trained memories [ 42 , 50 , 46 ] face sparse credit assignment, since most reward signal is several turns downstream of the responsible read/write decision. PreCoMem is complementary to all of these: it treats the write path as a single regime-gated decision driven by a calibrated prediction-error signal, instead of relying on recency heuristics or task-specific reward shaping.

paragraphs.en: Predictive coding theory holds that perceptual systems update internal models when observations deviate from prediction [ 8 , 3 ] , and information theory gives this deviation a precise scalar form: surprisal [ 19 , 29 ] . The same logic has long shaped accounts of episodic memory: novel events are encoded preferentially, and reactivation drives reconsolidation of related traces [ 33 , 36 ] . Translating this into long-term conversational memory requires two extra ingredients absent from prior memory systems. First, surprisal must be calibrated against retrieval reliability , otherwise diffuse recall produces noisy update signals [ 18 , 48 ] . Second, surprisal must be regime-gated , since consistent, ambiguous, and reliably contradictory evidence call for qualitatively different memory edits. PreCoMem operationalizes both ingredients: S eff S_{\mathrm{eff}} multiplies raw surprisal by an entropy-based reliability coefficient, and a two-threshold gate maps the result to MAINTAIN / PROFILE / CORRECT .
paragraphs.zh: 预测编码理论认为，当观测偏离预测时，知觉系统会更新内部模型 [8, 3]，而信息论为这种偏离给出了精确的标量形式：惊奇度 [19, 29]。 同样的逻辑长期以来也塑造了对情景记忆的解释：新异事件被优先编码，而再激活会驱动相关记忆痕迹的再巩固 [33, 36]。 将这一思路转化为长期对话记忆，需要两个以往记忆系统所不具备的额外要素。 第一，惊奇度必须根据检索可靠性进行校准，否则弥散的召回会产生带噪声的更新信号 [18, 48]。 第二，惊奇度必须按状态分门控，因为一致性证据、模糊证据和可靠的反驳证据需要性质上不同的记忆编辑操作。 PreCoMem 将这两个要素都进行了操作化：S eff S_{\mathrm{eff}} 将原始惊奇度乘以一个基于熵的可靠性系数，而一个双阈值门控将结果映射为 MAINTAIN / PROFILE / CORRECT。

paragraphs.en: LoCoMo [ 28 ] provides 1,500 + + questions over multi-session dialogues with explicit single-hop, multi-hop, temporal, and open-domain splits. LongMemEval - S [ 43 ] tests five core abilities (information extraction, multi-session reasoning, knowledge updates, temporal reasoning, abstention) with 500 questions over chat histories of roughly 115 115 k tokens each. PersonaMem - v2 [ 16 ] stresses implicit personalization across 1,000 1{,}000 personas and 20,000 + 20{,}000+ preferences, where most signal is buried in everyday task-oriented turns. Two more recent benchmarks move closer to the write path: AMemGym [ 1 ] evaluates memory on-policy against a simulated user whose latent task state changes across periods, and LoCoMo - Plus [ 22 ] probes implicit cognitive constraints (causal, state, goal, and value) over long dialogues; we report both in Section C.1 . EvalMem [ 26 ] complements these end-task benchmarks with an operation-level diagnostic framework that scores individual memory operations such as adding, updating, and deleting items. These benchmarks probe the read path or the end result of memory updates; none of them, however, isolates the write-path decision under continuous, gradual drift with adversarial retrieval interference. Our companion benchmark DiMoBench fills this gap with five independent 350 350 -turn dialogues, one per persona, whose latent attitudes reverse gradually across change points; an extended variant, DiMoBench - XL , contains five independent 1050 1050 -turn dialogues, each with three sequential drifts.

paragraphs.en: We deliberately apply the w t ​ ( m ) < 0.1 w_{t}(m)<0.1 pruning rule only to hypotheses, not to facts. Two design considerations motivate this asymmetry. First, because retrieval is confidence-weighted, an outdated fact with w ≈ 0.02 w\!\approx\!0.02 contributes roughly 50 × \times less to the retrieval score than a currently supported fact with w ≈ 1 w\!\approx\!1 ; such items are naturally pushed out of the Top- K K evidence set by currently supported beliefs and become functionally inactive under confidence-weighted retrieval even though they remain in storage. Second, long-horizon dialogue often revisits past user traits after long gaps (e.g., a user stops drinking coffee for months and then mentions it again); retaining the deprecated fact at low confidence preserves the reasoning chain and episodic-cache links needed to recover such context, whereas hard deletion would force the system to rebuild that trait from scratch. The resulting effective memory , i.e., the subset of items that can still influence Top- K K retrieval, therefore remains controlled even if raw storage accumulates history. Under truly extreme horizons, raw storage can be further bounded by a timestamped time-to-live on long-deprecated facts without modifying the core operators; we leave this as an engineering safeguard rather than a core mechanism.
paragraphs.zh: 我们刻意将 w t ​ ( m ) < 0.1 w_{t}(m)<0.1 的剪枝规则只应用于假设，而不应用于事实。 有两个设计考量促成了这种不对称性。 首先，由于检索采用置信度加权，一条 w ≈ 0.02 w\!\approx\!0.02 的过时事实对检索得分的贡献大约比一条 w ≈ 1 w\!\approx\!1 的当前受支持事实低 50 × \times ；在置信度加权检索下，这类条目会被当前受支持的信念自然挤出 Top- K K 证据集，即使它们仍保留在存储中，也在功能上处于不活跃状态。 其次，长程对话往往在很长时间间隔后重新提及过去的用户特征（例如，用户停止喝咖啡数月后再次提到这件事）；以低置信度保留该已弃用事实，可以保住恢复此类上下文所需的推理链和情景缓存链接，而硬删除将迫使系统从头重建该特征。 因此，由此形成的有效记忆，即仍能影响 Top- K K 检索的条目子集，即便原始存储不断累积历史，也能保持受控。 在真正极端的时间跨度下，可以通过对长期弃用事实施加带时间戳的生存时间来进一步限制原始存储，而无需修改核心算子；我们将此作为工程层面的保障措施，而非核心机制。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 makes the hybrid execution discussed in Section 2.4 explicit. Each turn invokes (i) a deterministic Retrieve step, (ii) a deterministic computation of ρ t , S raw , x t \rho_{t},S_{\mathrm{raw}},x_{t} , (iii) a regime-specific LLM sub-agent (one of Maintain-Agent , Profile-Agent , Correct-Agent ; prompts in Appendix D ) that emits per-item scalar scores, and (iv) a deterministic application of the closed-form updates in Equations 7 , 8 and 10 . The sub-agents only inject which items to touch and how strongly ; gating, soft-decay, reinforcement, and hypothesis-promotion mechanics are entirely symbolic.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 将第 2.4 节讨论的混合执行方式显式化。 每一轮都会调用：(i) 一个确定性的 Retrieve 步骤；(ii) 对 ρ t , S raw , x t \rho_{t},S_{\mathrm{raw}},x_{t} 的确定性计算；(iii) 一个针对特定状态的 LLM 子智能体（Maintain-Agent、Profile-Agent、Correct-Agent 之一；提示词见附录 D），该子智能体输出逐项的标量分数；(iv) 对公式 7、8 和 10 中闭式更新的确定性应用。 子智能体只注入要触及哪些条目以及触及的强度；门控、软衰减、强化和假设提升机制完全是符号化的。

paragraphs.en: To test whether the write-path advantage transfers to data we did not design, we evaluate PreCoMem on two public benchmarks built by other groups: AMemGym [ 1 ] , an on-policy benchmark with gold state transitions in which a simulated user’s latent task state (for example a project’s preparation stage or budget band) changes across periods, and LoCoMo - Plus [ 22 ] , a static benchmark of 401 implicit cognitive-constraint questions. Both are run under their official protocols with the same backbone for all compared systems.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验写入路径优势是否能迁移到非我们设计的数据上，我们在两个由其他团队构建的公开基准上评估 PreCoMem：AMemGym [ 1 ]，这是一个具有黄金状态转移的在线策略（on-policy）基准，其中模拟用户的潜在任务状态（例如项目的准备阶段或预算区间）会随周期变化；以及 LoCoMo - Plus [ 22 ]，这是一个包含 401 道内隐认知约束问题的静态基准。 两者均在其官方协议下运行，且所有被比较的系统使用相同的主干模型。

paragraphs.en: We use the official on-policy v1.base release (code snapshot ffcd188 , data 4b8f64f ) at the official 20-profile / 11-period setting (ten gold state transitions per profile; 943 sessions and 2,200 questions per run) with three paired seeds ( 13 , 42 , 1234 ) (13,42,1234) . The user simulator is gpt-4.1 ( T = 0.2 T{=}0.2 ); PreCoMem and all of its variants use gpt-4.1-mini ( T = 0 T{=}0 ) with text-embedding-3-small , Top- K = 10 K{=}10 , ( θ low , θ high ) = ( 0.2 , 0.6 ) (\theta_{\mathrm{low}},\theta_{\mathrm{high}})=(0.2,0.6) and λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 . Each AMemGym session is a single user turn, so one gate event is logged per session. We report the benchmark’s two headline scores, the Overall accuracy over the 2,200 questions and the normalized Memory score defined by AMemGym (Overall rescaled between the benchmark’s random-answer and upper-bound references), together with its native write / read / utilization failure rates. Table 3 compares PreCoMem with the strongest systems reported in the AMemGym paper under the same gpt-4.1-mini backbone: PreCoMem leads the strongest of them (AWE) by + 0.028 +0.028 Overall and + 0.033 +0.033 Memory, so the advantage reproduces on data we did not design.

paragraphs.en: To see which operator carries the gain, we remove each operator in turn on the same runs ( Table 4 ). Besides the native scores we track, per seed, 203 probes that query an attribute in the first period after its transition (changed-state probes) and 397 probes on unchanged attributes (stable-state probes). Changed-state and stable-state accuracy are the accuracies on these two probe sets; first-write is the share of changed-state probes for which the belief that dominates retrieval already encodes the new value; stale-state error is the share of changed-state probes answered with the superseded value; recovery is the mean number of periods until a changed-state probe that was not immediately correct is answered correctly; and old-state suppression is the share of changed-state probes for which the superseded belief is absent from the answering Top-10 or ranked below the new one. The three operators leave three distinct signatures, matching Figure 4 (c): removing PROFILE mainly costs first-write success and changed-state accuracy; removing CORRECT raises the stale-state error, stretches recovery from one period to three, and degrades old-state suppression the most; removing MAINTAIN degrades stable-state accuracy together with the highest read and utilization failure. Paired 95% confidence intervals of Full minus each variant (three seeds, t t -distribution) exclude zero on every metric; for the Memory score they are 0.020 ​ [ 0.011 , 0.029 ] 0.020\,[0.011,0.029] , 0.026 ​ [ 0.012 , 0.040 ] 0.026\,[0.012,0.040] and 0.056 ​ [ 0.040 , 0.072 ] 0.056\,[0.040,0.072] for the three variants. paragraphs.en: Operator ablations of this kind need a gold transition timeline that splits accuracy into stable, change-point and recovery phases. Static question-answering benchmarks such as LoCoMo and LongMemEval - S yield a single end number per run and cannot attribute an effect to one operator, which is why we report operator ablations on AMemGym and DiMoBench and complement them with the route-matched controls of Section C.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 这类算子消融实验需要一个黄金转移时间线，以便将准确率划分为稳定、变化点和恢复三个阶段。 诸如 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval-S 这类静态问答基准测试在每次运行中只产生一个最终数字，无法将效果归因于某个单一算子，这正是我们在 AMemGym 和 DiMoBench 上报告算子消融结果、并用第 C.4 节的路径匹配对照实验加以补充的原因。

paragraphs.en: LoCoMo - Plus contains 401 questions that probe implicit cognitive constraints of four types (causal 101, state 100, goal 100, value 100) and scores each answer by constraint-consistency accuracy (%), averaged over repeated judgments so that scores are not integer counts. All systems answer with GPT-4o. PreCoMem reaches 22.4 ± 0.8 22.4\pm 0.8 overall, above A-Mem ( 17.2 17.2 ), Mem0 ( 15.8 15.8 ), SeCom [ 31 ] ( 14.9 14.9 ) and even full-context GPT-4o ( 21.05 21.05 ), as reported in the LoCoMo - Plus paper. Table 5 breaks the score down by type against the w/o PROFILE control: the gains are largest on the non-preference types goal ( + 5.0 +5.0 ) and state ( + 4.8 +4.8 ), smaller on value ( + 3.0 +3.0 ), and within seed noise on causal ( + 1.1 ± 0.5 +1.1\pm 0.5 ), whose questions depend more on backbone reasoning than on the write path. Together with the task-state targets tracked by AMemGym, this shows the mechanism operating beyond preference modeling: nothing in the effective surprisal, the gate or the closed-form updates is preference-specific, since a belief is any compact claim carrying a confidence weight.
paragraphs.zh: LoCoMo-Plus 包含 401 个问题，用于探测四种类型的隐式认知约束（因果 101、状态 100、目标 100、价值 100），并以约束一致性准确率（%）对每个答案评分，通过对多次评判取平均，使分数不是整数计数。 所有系统均使用 GPT-4o 作答。 如 LoCoMo-Plus 论文所报告，PreCoMem 总体达到 22.4 ± 0.8 22.4\pm 0.8，高于 A-Mem（17.2 17.2）、Mem0（15.8 15.8）、SeCom [31]（14.9 14.9），甚至高于全上下文 GPT-4o（21.05 21.05）。 表 5 对照 w/o PROFILE 控制组按类型分解了得分：在非偏好类型目标（+5.0 +5.0）和状态（+4.8 +4.8）上增益最大，在价值（+3.0 +3.0）上较小，而在因果（+1.1 ± 0.5 +1.1\pm 0.5）上处于随机种子噪声范围内，因为该类问题更多依赖于骨干推理而非写入路径。 结合 AMemGym 跟踪的任务状态目标，这表明该机制的作用超越了偏好建模：有效惊讶度、门控和闭式更新中没有任何部分是偏好特定的，因为信念可以是任何携带置信权重的紧凑断言。

paragraphs.en: Each x-axis group of Figure 3 (a)–(d) fixes the model that answers the questions: Qwen3.5-35B, Qwen3.5-122B or GPT-5-Chat. The two bars of a group differ only in how memory is built and maintained. The left bar runs the answer model with its own native memory, instantiated by O-Mem at the same scale, so every such bar already includes a full memory system. The right bar keeps the answer model unchanged and delegates memory construction (the write path and retrieval) to PreCoMem running on a one-tier-smaller backbone: Qwen3.5-9B for the Qwen3.5-35B group, Qwen3.5-35B for the Qwen3.5-122B group, and GPT-5-mini for the GPT-5-Chat group. The right bar exceeds the left one in every group and on every dataset (all twelve Δ > 0 \Delta>0 ): memory construction can be delegated to a much cheaper model and still beat the larger model’s native memory, i.e., with the answer model held equal the mechanism substitutes for roughly one tier of model scale.
paragraphs.zh: 图3(a)–(d)的每个x轴分组固定回答问题的模型：Qwen3.5-35B、Qwen3.5-122B或GPT-5-Chat。 每组内的两根柱子仅在记忆的构建与维护方式上不同。 左侧柱子让回答模型使用其自身的原生记忆，该记忆由同尺度的O-Mem实例化，因此每个这样的柱子本身已包含完整的记忆系统。 右侧柱子保持回答模型不变，将记忆构建（写入路径与检索）委托给运行在小一档骨干上的PreCoMem：Qwen3.5-35B组使用Qwen3.5-9B，Qwen3.5-122B组使用Qwen3.5-35B，GPT-5-Chat组使用GPT-5-mini。 右侧柱子在所有分组和所有数据集上都超过左侧柱子（全部十二个Δ > 0 \Delta>0）：记忆构建可以委托给便宜得多的模型，并且仍能胜过更大模型的原生记忆，也就是说，在回答模型相同的条件下，该机制可替代大约一档的模型规模。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 reports the per-query token usage of the response model on all three benchmarks under the same accounting as the Avg. Tokens column of Table 1 : the mean number of input tokens sent to the response model per query (retrieved memory, short-term window, question and instructions), excluding memory-construction calls. PreCoMem’s prompt is bounded by construction (Top- K = 10 K{=}10 beliefs, a six-turn window and at most eight episodic excerpts), so its budget grows only from 3.1k on LoCoMo to 3.8k on LongMemEval - S under gpt-4.1 , and by under 9% when the PersonaMem - v2 context quadruples from 32k to 128k. On every benchmark no baseline is both cheaper and more accurate than PreCoMem, while MemOS and EverMemOS use 0.6–1.4k fewer tokens per query at lower accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 表 6 报告了响应模型在全部三个基准上每次查询的 token 用量，其统计口径与表 1 的 Avg. Tokens 列相同。 即每次查询发送给响应模型的平均输入 token 数（检索到的记忆、短期窗口、问题和指令），不包括记忆构建调用。 PreCoMem 的提示词长度在构建上是有界的（Top-K=10 条信念、六轮窗口以及至多八条情节摘录），因此在 gpt-4.1 下其预算仅从 LoCoMo 上的 3.1k 增长到 LongMemEval-S 上的 3.8k，并且当 PersonaMem-v2 的上下文从 32k 增至 128k（翻两番）时增长不到 9%。 在每个基准上，没有任何基线方法比 PreCoMem 更便宜且更准确，而 MemOS 和 EverMemOS 虽然每次查询少用 0.6–1.4k 个 token，但准确率更低。

paragraphs.en: For completeness, Table 7 reports the LongMemEval - S results under the gpt-4o-mini backbone (omitted from the main Table 1 to save space). The pattern mirrors gpt-4.1 : PreCoMem leads on overall accuracy ( ± 0.05 84.28\!\pm\!0.05 , + 1.96 +1.96 over the strongest baseline EverMemOS) and on SSA, SSP, MS, and KU. These columns cover assistant-side single-session recall (SSA), preference-conditioned response generation (SSP), cross-session aggregation (MS), and knowledge updates (KU), while EverMemOS retains an SSU lead from its read-path optimization and TiMem leads on temporal reasoning (TR).

paragraphs.en: To validate the reliability of our automated evaluation, we conduct a per-category human–LLM agreement study on all three benchmarks. Table 8 pools the results: across LoCoMo (199-QA stratified audit), LongMemEval - S (full 500 QAs), and DiMoBench (200-QA audit covering one canonical persona), the gpt-4.1-mini primary judge agrees with expert human re-annotation at 96.9 % 96.9\% overall ( 93.8 93.8 – 98.5 % 98.5\% per question type) with Cohen’s κ \kappa between 0.81 0.81 and 0.96 0.96 in every question type ( 0.957 0.957 , 0.878 0.878 and 0.821 0.821 at the dataset level for LoCoMo, LongMemEval - S and DiMoBench). κ \kappa is lowest on DiMoBench, which combines the lowest agreement ( 95.4 % 95.4\% ) with a high chance-agreement baseline: both raters mark about 85% of its answers correct, so more of the agreement is expected by chance than on LoCoMo, where about 72% are marked correct. To rule out the concern that the judge might be calibrated only on PreCoMem outputs, we additionally re-ran the same human-vs-judge study on 50 50 outputs each from the two strongest baselines (EverMemOS and TiMem) on LoCoMo and LongMemEval - S; agreement remained within a ± 0.7 \pm 0.7 -point band of the pooled PreCoMem agreement ( 96.4 96.4 – 97.5 % 97.5\% ), confirming that the protocol is stable across systems. This supports the use of LLM-as-a-judge in our experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 为验证自动化评估的可靠性，我们在全部三个基准上开展了分类别的人类—LLM一致性研究。 表8汇总了结果：在LoCoMo（199条问答的分层审计）、LongMemEval-S（全部500条问答）以及DiMoBench（覆盖一个标准角色的200条问答审计）上，主裁判gpt-4.1-mini与专家人类重新标注的总体一致率为96.9%（各题型为93.8–98.5%），且每种题型的Cohen's κ都在0.81到0.96之间（在LoCoMo、LongMemEval-S和DiMoBench数据集层面分别为0.957、0.878和0.821）。κ在DiMoBench上最低，这是因为其一致性最低（95.4%）同时偶然一致性基线较高：两位标注者都将其约85%的答案标为正确，因此相比约72%答案被标为正确的LoCoMo，DiMoBench上更多的一致性可以由偶然因素解释。 为排除裁判模型可能仅针对PreCoMem输出进行校准的担忧，我们另外在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上，对两个最强基线（EverMemOS和TiMem）各50条输出重新开展了相同的人类与裁判一致性研究；一致率仍保持在汇总的PreCoMem一致率±0.7个百分点的范围内（96.4–97.5%），这证实了该评估协议在不同系统间是稳定的。 这支持了在我们的实验中使用LLM作为裁判的做法。

paragraphs.en: To make self-evolution observable , we treat hypotheses as lifecycle objects that can be created, implicitly verified, promoted, or expired (illustrated in Figure 6 ). Table 9 reports aggregate statistics on LoCoMo (averaged over 10 samples). Removing retrieval-reliability adjustment (w/o C1) increases hypothesis creation but reduces promotion precision, while removing the intermediate PROFILE regime (w/o C2) weakens gradual adaptation. Without the hypothesis lifecycle (w/o C3), these lifecycle metrics become undefined, since medium-surprisal information is written as facts directly.
paragraphs.zh: 为了使自我进化可被观察，我们将假设视为具有生命周期的对象，可以被创建、隐式验证、晋升或过期（如图 6 所示）。 表 9 报告了 LoCoMo 上的汇总统计数据（对 10 个样本取平均）。 移除检索可靠性调整（w/o C1）会增加假设的创建数量，但会降低晋升的精确度；而移除中间的 PROFILE 机制（w/o C2）会削弱渐进式适应。 在没有假设生命周期（w/o C3）的情况下，这些生命周期指标将变得无法定义，因为中等惊异度的信息会被直接写为事实。

paragraphs.en: The attribution of the gains in the main text rests on the benchmark annotations. On LoCoMo, Open-Domain is the only split whose questions are inferential in form (20.8% begin with “Would/Might/What would…”) and whose gold answers are hedged inferences (14.6%); every other split scores 0.0% on both. Its target is typically a state not stated in a single turn: 49.0% of its questions carry two or more evidence pointers and 32.3% span two or more sessions (mean gap 4.51 sessions). Session span alone does not explain this: Multi-Hop spans more sessions (10.27 on average) yet has no hedged answers, since it joins co-valid stated facts, whereas Open-Domain must infer and revise a latent state. Temporal resolves from a single evidence pointer in 87.5% of cases, which is why no gain appears there. On LongMemEval - S, all 78 KU questions have exactly two answer sessions, an old value and the value superseding it, so an un-updated memory is wrong by construction; SSA questions instead have one answer session whose gold evidence lies in assistant turns (51 of 56), a single target among 48.9 48.9 sessions on average, so the SSA gain comes from confidence-weighted retrieval acting as an implicit reranker. We therefore attribute the drift-related gains to KU, SSP, cross-session MS and Open-Domain, and describe SSA as selective memory use.
paragraphs.zh: 正文中的增益归因依赖于基准测试的标注。 在 LoCoMo 上，Open-Domain 是唯一一个问题形式为推断式（20.8% 以 "Would/Might/What would…" 开头）且标准答案为带保留的推断（14.6%）的划分；其余所有划分在这两项上均为 0.0%。 其目标通常是未在单轮对话中明确陈述的状态：49.0% 的问题带有两个或更多证据指针，32.3% 跨越两个或更多会话（平均间隔 4.51 个会话）。 仅凭会话跨度无法解释这一点：Multi-Hop 跨越更多会话（平均 10.27 个）却没有带保留的答案，因为它连接的是同时有效且明确陈述的事实，而 Open-Domain 则必须推断并修正一个潜在状态。 Temporal 在 87.5% 的情况下仅凭单个证据指针即可解决，这就是为什么它没有出现增益。 在 LongMemEval-S 上，所有 78 个 KU 问题都恰好有两个答案会话，一个是旧值，一个是取代它的值，因此未更新的记忆在构造上就是错误的；SSA 问题则只有一个答案会话，其标准证据位于智能体轮次中（56 个中的 51 个），是平均 48.9 个会话中的单一目标，因此 SSA 的增益来自充当隐式重排器的置信度加权检索。 因此，我们将与漂移相关的增益归因于 KU、SSP、跨会话 MS 和 Open-Domain，并将 SSA 描述为选择性记忆使用。

paragraphs.en: The raw-surprisal term S raw = λ ​ d sem + ( 1 − λ ) ​ d conf S_{\mathrm{raw}}=\lambda\,d_{\mathrm{sem}}+(1-\lambda)\,d_{\mathrm{conf}} mixes a semantic-gap signal and a verifier-based contradiction signal ( Equation 4 , Section B.2 ). To disentangle their individual contributions, we ablate each component by forcing one branch to zero. w/o d sem d_{\mathrm{sem}} sets λ = 0 \lambda\!=\!0 , keeping only the contradiction verifier; w/o d conf d_{\mathrm{conf}} sets λ = 1 \lambda\!=\!1 , keeping only the semantic gap. As shown in Table 10 , both components are useful, but d conf d_{\mathrm{conf}} contributes substantially more: removing it costs − 10.08 -10.08 points on LoCoMo and − 11.57 -11.57 points on LongMemEval - S, roughly double the drop from removing d sem d_{\mathrm{sem}} ( − 5.74 -5.74 and − 6.63 -6.63 points respectively). This matches the design intuition: the semantic gap alone cannot distinguish a genuinely contradictory utterance from one that is merely off-topic relative to current memory, whereas the NLI-based contradiction score directly detects reliable negation and drives CORRECT . Keeping both signals, on the other hand, gives the best trade-off between sensitivity (detecting drift cues via d sem d_{\mathrm{sem}} ) and precision (avoiding spurious corrections via d conf d_{\mathrm{conf}} ).

paragraphs.en: We ablate PreCoMem’s three evolution operators on DiMoBench: PROFILE (hypothesis writing), CORRECT (surprisal-gated soft correction), and MAINTAIN (reinforcement/smoothing). We report accuracy every 10 turns from turn 150 to 350. As shown in Figure 4 (c), removing PROFILE lowers the final accuracy ceiling (72%), removing CORRECT substantially slows post-drift recovery, and removing MAINTAIN leads to high-variance dynamics that do not stabilize within our evaluation horizon (ending at 54% accuracy).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 DiMoBench 上对 PreCoMem 的三个演化算子进行消融实验：PROFILE（撰写假设）、CORRECT（基于惊讶度门控的软校正）和 MAINTAIN（强化/平滑）。 我们从第 150 轮到第 350 轮，每 10 轮报告一次准确率。 如图 4 (c) 所示，移除 PROFILE 会降低最终准确率上限（72%），移除 CORRECT 会显著减慢漂移后的恢复速度，而移除 MAINTAIN 则会导致高方差的动态，无法在我们的评估时间范围内趋于稳定（最终准确率为 54%）。

paragraphs.en: DiMoBench is designed to separate three regimes that stress different update behaviors: a stable pre-change phase (turns ≈ \approx 150–200), a short change-point phase with mixed/ambiguous cues and decoy retrieval (turns ≈ \approx 200–240), and a stable post-change phase where the latent attitude has reversed (turns ≈ \approx 240–350). Under this structure, the three operators contribute in complementary ways.
paragraphs.zh: DiMoBench 旨在区分三个考验不同更新行为的阶段：一个稳定的变化前阶段（轮次 ≈ 150–200）、一个短暂的变化点阶段（包含混合/模糊线索与诱饵检索，轮次 ≈ 200–240），以及一个潜在态度已发生反转的稳定变化后阶段（轮次 ≈ 240–350）。 在这一结构下，三种算子以互补的方式发挥作用。

paragraphs.en: PROFILE : buffered adaptation under implicit drift. Many change-point cues are neither clean confirmations nor decisive contradictions: they are novel, partially ambiguous, and often entangled with confounders. PROFILE converts these medium- S eff S_{\mathrm{eff}} signals into low-confidence, testable hypotheses, enabling the system to accumulate multiple weak cues before committing. This “waiting room” is especially important on DiMoBench because questions explicitly probe trend/change-point reasoning and hypothesis-vs-fact distinction. When PROFILE is removed, the system loses this intermediate representation and commits weak cues without a waiting room (premature commitment under decoys), which reduces the asymptotic ceiling (72% vs. 84% for full PreCoMem).
paragraphs.zh: PROFILE：隐式漂移下的缓冲式适应。许多变化点线索既非清晰的确认，也非决定性的反驳：它们是新颖的、部分模糊的，且常常与混杂因素纠缠在一起。PROFILE 将这些中等强度的有效信号 S_{\mathrm{eff}} 转化为低置信度、可检验的假设，使系统能够在做出承诺之前累积多个弱线索。这种“候诊室”机制在 DiMoBench 上尤为重要，因为其中的问题明确考察趋势/变化点推理以及假设与事实的区分。当移除 PROFILE 后，系统失去了这一中间表示，在没有候诊室的情况下就贸然采纳弱线索（在诱饵干扰下过早承诺），从而导致渐近上限下降（72%，而完整的 PreCoMem 为 84%）。

paragraphs.en: CORRECT : targeted suppression of outdated beliefs. After the drift, previously correct high-confidence beliefs become systematically misleading, and decoy retrieval makes stale evidence likely to reappear. CORRECT provides a selective revision mechanism by downweighting contradicted items via the ζ t ​ ( m ) \zeta_{t}(m) -modulated soft decay while leaving non-contradictory items largely unchanged. This targeted decay is crucial for reducing old-memory pull and preventing interference from pre-change beliefs. Without CORRECT , outdated facts remain competitive in retrieval, so the agent must rely on accumulating new nodes and indirect effects to “outvote” entrenched beliefs, yielding a substantially slower recovery (reaching 75% only around turn 320 vs. turn 250) and a lower final plateau (77% vs. 84%).
paragraphs.zh: CORRECT：对过时信念进行定向抑制。 漂移发生后，先前正确的高置信度信念会系统性地变成误导性信念，而诱饵检索会使陈旧证据很容易重新出现。 CORRECT 通过由 ζ t ​ ( m ) \zeta_{t}(m) 调制的软衰减来降低被矛盾条目的权重，同时基本保持非矛盾条目不变，从而提供了一种选择性修正机制。 这种定向衰减对于降低旧记忆的拉扯、防止变更前信念的干扰至关重要。 没有 CORRECT 时，过时事实在检索中仍具竞争力，因此智能体只能依靠积累新节点和间接影响来“投票压倒”根深蒂固的信念，导致恢复速度大幅变慢（约在 320 轮才达到 75%，而非 250 轮），且最终平台期更低（77% 对 84%）。

paragraphs.en: MAINTAIN : consolidation for stability. MAINTAIN acts as a consolidation step that repeatedly reinforces supported beliefs, which sharpens confidence-weighted retrieval, increases retrieval reliability ρ t \rho_{t} (by making the score mass more concentrated), and stabilizes the routing signal x t ( = S eff ) x_{t}(=S_{\mathrm{eff}}) . It also underpins the hypothesis lifecycle: hypotheses created by PROFILE require repeated reinforcement to cross the promotion threshold and become stable facts. This stabilization is critical in the post-change phase, where the system should stop oscillating and settle into the post-change regime. When MAINTAIN is ablated, supported post-change beliefs cannot be progressively consolidated; retrieval remains diffuse and volatile, the reliability-adjusted loss becomes noisy, and updates keep “chasing” confounded evidence. Empirically, this yields persistent volatility: accuracy continues to fluctuate and ends at 54% at the end of our evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: MAINTAIN：巩固以保持稳定。MAINTAIN 充当巩固步骤，反复强化得到支持的信息（信念），从而锐化置信度加权检索，提高检索可靠性 ρ t \rho_{t}（通过使分数质量更加集中），并稳定路由信号 x t ( = S eff ) x_{t}(=S_{\mathrm{eff}})。它还支撑假设的生命周期：由 PROFILE 创建的假设需要反复强化才能跨越晋升阈值并成为稳定的事实。这种稳定化在变化后阶段至关重要，此时系统应停止震荡并稳定到变化后的状态。当移除 MAINTAIN 时，得到支持的、变化后的信念无法被逐步巩固；检索保持分散且不稳定，经过可靠性调整的损失变得充满噪声，更新会持续“追逐”被混杂的证据。从实证上看，这导致了持续的波动性：准确率持续波动，并在我们评估结束时停留在 54%。

paragraphs.en: A natural alternative to the hybrid design of Section 2.1 is to let the same LLM decide the whole write step. The direct-write baseline matches PreCoMem in every other component (retrieval, embedding, Top- K = 10 K{=}10 , context, judge, seeds, gpt-4.1 ); the only change is that the LLM emits the entire write decision as one object, { route , target_ids , operation , new_weights , new_belief }, whose weights are written verbatim, replacing the gate, the closed-form updates and the [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] clamping. Table 13 shows that accuracy is lower in every seed ( − 2.75 -2.75 on LoCoMo, − 3.15 -3.15 on LongMemEval - S) while per-query tokens are slightly higher (3.2k / 3.9k against 3.1k / 3.8k), so the loss is not offset by efficiency. The more telling difference is stability: the cross-seed standard deviation is 20 × 20\times higher on LoCoMo (1.42 against 0.07) and 2.1 × 2.1\times higher on LongMemEval - S, because unconstrained numeric decisions make the memory trajectory run-dependent. Replaying the write decisions on a frozen store, direct write emits a missing target id in 3.6% of decisions, a self-contradictory operation in 2.7% and invalid JSON in 1.8% (mutually exclusive categories); such malformed writes corrupt the store silently and compound, whereas the closed-form updates stay in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] by construction. The loss is spread over all LoCoMo splits (Single-Hop − 1.65 -1.65 , Multi-Hop − 4.80 -4.80 , Temporal − 2.70 -2.70 , Open-Domain − 6.50 -6.50 ). The deterministic layer is what keeps long-horizon memory bounded.
paragraphs.zh: 对第2.1节的混合设计，一种自然的替代方案是让同一个大语言模型（LLM）决定整个写入步骤。 直接写入基线在其他所有组件上（检索、嵌入、Top- K = 10 K{=}10 、上下文、评判器、随机种子、gpt-4.1）都与 PreCoMem 保持一致；唯一的改动是 LLM 将整个写入决策作为单一对象输出，即 { route , target_ids , operation , new_weights , new_belief }，其中的权重被原样写入，从而取代门控机制、闭式更新以及 [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] 截断。 表13显示，在每个随机种子下准确率都更低（LoCoMo 上 − 2.75 -2.75 ，LongMemEval - S 上 − 3.15 -3.15 ），而每查询的 token 数略高（3.2k / 3.9k 对比 3.1k / 3.8k），因此效率上的提升并不能弥补这一损失。 更能说明问题的差异在于稳定性：LoCoMo 上的跨种子标准差高出 20 × 20\times （1.42 对比 0.07），LongMemEval - S 上高出 2.1 × 2.1\times ，这是因为不受约束的数值决策会使记忆轨迹依赖于具体的运行过程。 在冻结的存储上回放写入决策时，直接写入在 3.6% 的决策中会输出缺失的目标 id，在 2.7% 的决策中输出自相矛盾的操作，在 1.8% 的决策中输出无效 JSON（这些类别互不重叠）；这类格式错误的写入会悄悄地破坏存储并不断累积，而闭式更新则通过构造天然保持在 [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] 范围内。 这一损失分布在 LoCoMo 的所有子集上（单跳 − 1.65 -1.65 ，多跳 − 4.80 -4.80 ，时序 − 2.70 -2.70 ，开放域 − 6.50 -6.50 ）。 正是确定性层使长程记忆保持在有界范围内。

paragraphs.en: PreCoMem computes one gate score per turn and routes the whole retrieved set to a single operator; the per-item magnitudes η t ​ ( m ) \eta_{t}(m) and ζ t ​ ( m ) \zeta_{t}(m) apply after routing. A turn can therefore reinforce several beliefs, or correct several beliefs, at once, but it cannot reinforce one belief, correct another and profile a third in the same step. To measure how often this matters we annotated gold operators per retrieved item on 9,006 turns (all LoCoMo dialogues plus the LongMemEval - S evidence sessions): 3,475 turns touch at least one retrieved belief, and 95.83% of them are expressible by a single route, either a single belief or several beliefs sharing one operator. The remaining 145 turns (1.61% of all turns, 21.4% of the 678 multi-item turns) are genuinely mixed. A per-item variant, identical in retrieval, backbone and closed-form updates but routing each item independently, raises the whole-turn agreement with the gold operators on these 145 turns by + 5.5 +5.5 points and their question accuracy by + 3.5 +3.5 points, at + 31 % +31\% write calls and + 14 % +14\% write tokens, for a net gain of + 0.3 +0.3 points over the full evaluation. Given the small net benefit at a materially higher cost, we keep turn-level routing as the default and regard per-item claim extraction as a direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: PreCoMem 每轮计算一个门控分数，并将整个检索集合路由到单一算子；逐条目的幅度 η_t(m) 与 ζ_t(m) 在路由之后才生效。 因此，一轮可以同时强化多个信念，或同时纠正多个信念，但无法在同一步中强化一个信念、纠正另一个信念并对第三个信念进行画像。 为衡量这种情况出现的频率，我们在 9,006 轮（全部 LoCoMo 对话以及 LongMemEval-S 证据会话）上对每条检索条目标注了黄金算子：其中 3,475 轮涉及至少一个检索到的信念，而这些轮次中有 95.83% 可由单一路由表达，即要么是单个信念，要么是共享同一算子的多个信念。 剩余的 145 轮（占全部轮次的 1.61%，占 678 个多条目轮次的 21.4%）是真正的混合情况。 一种逐条目的变体——在检索、骨干模型与闭式更新上完全相同，但独立路由每个条目——在这 145 轮上将整轮与黄金算子的一致性提升 +5.5 分，将其问题准确率提升 +3.5 分，代价是写入调用增加 +31%、写入 token 增加 +14%，在完整评测上的净收益为 +0.3 分。 鉴于收益微小而成本显著增加，我们保留轮级路由作为默认设置，并将逐条目主张提取视为未来工作的方向。

paragraphs.en: Theoretically, one may dynamically compute or adapt the thresholds (e.g., by estimating the action costs/effects in Equation 27 ), which could yield better per-sample or per-stage performance. However, such on-policy adaptation introduces additional computation and confounds controlled evaluation because the observed behavior becomes entangled with an evolving threshold schedule.
paragraphs.zh: 理论上，可以动态计算或自适应地调整阈值（例如，通过估计公式27中的动作代价/效果），这可能带来更好的逐样本或逐阶段性能。 然而，这种在策略（on-policy）自适应会引入额外的计算，并使受控评估变得混乱，因为观察到的行为会与不断演变的阈值调度纠缠在一起。

paragraphs.en: Importantly, this fixed choice is a trade-off: we do not claim ( 0.2 , 0.6 ) (0.2,0.6) is universally optimal for every LoCoMo sample. Rather, it provides a stable and interpretable operating point with competitive accuracy under a fixed computational budget, and we keep it constant across experiments for fair comparison and reproducible observations.

paragraphs.en: One natural question is whether the fixed gating thresholds ( θ low , θ high ) = ( 0.2 , 0.6 ) (\theta_{\mathrm{low}},\theta_{\mathrm{high}})=(0.2,0.6) are appropriate for all users, or whether different user populations would benefit from different thresholds. Intuitively, users differ in belief stability : some keep stable preferences so that short-term deviations are noise, while others change frequently so that the same deviations reflect real drift. A fixed threshold cannot simultaneously satisfy both regimes. We therefore discuss and evaluate a simple adaptive-thresholding extension of PreCoMem.
paragraphs.zh: 一个自然的问题是，固定的门控阈值 ( θ low , θ high ) = ( 0.2 , 0.6 ) 是否适用于所有用户，还是不同的用户群体会因不同的阈值而受益。 直觉上，用户在信念稳定性上存在差异：有些用户的偏好保持稳定，因而短期偏差只是噪声；而另一些用户则频繁改变，因而同样的偏差反映的是真实的漂移。 固定阈值无法同时满足这两种情形。 因此，我们讨论并评估一种对 PreCoMem 的简单自适应阈值扩展方法。

paragraphs.en: From a Bayesian perspective, the thresholds encode a prior on belief persistence: stable users have a stronger prior that beliefs are unchanged, so a higher θ high \theta_{\mathrm{high}} corresponds to requiring stronger likelihood evidence to revise them, and vice versa for dynamic users. From a signal detection perspective, θ low \theta_{\mathrm{low}} and θ high \theta_{\mathrm{high}} trade off false-update rate (triggering CORRECT on noise) against missed-update rate (failing to trigger on genuine drift); since these two error rates have different relative costs for different users, the Bayes-optimal decision boundary is user-dependent. Equation 37 is a minimal realization of this idea that only reads summary statistics PreCoMem already maintains and introduces no extra trainable parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 从贝叶斯的视角来看，这些阈值编码了关于信念持续性的先验：稳定型用户拥有更强的“信念不变”先验，因此较高的 θ high \theta_{\mathrm{high}} 意味着需要更强的似然证据才能修正信念，动态型用户则相反。 从信号检测的视角来看，θ low \theta_{\mathrm{low}} 与 θ high \theta_{\mathrm{high}} 在误更新率（在噪声上触发 CORRECT）与漏更新率（在真实漂移上未能触发）之间进行权衡；由于这两类错误率对不同用户具有不同的相对代价，贝叶斯最优决策边界是因用户而异的。 公式 37 是这一思想的最小化实现，它只读取 PreCoMem 已经维护的摘要统计量，并且不引入任何额外的可训练参数。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the adaptive variant, denoted PreCoMem (DT) , on the full LoCoMo benchmark with two backbones ( gpt-4o-mini and gpt-4.1 ), keeping every other setting identical to the main experiments. As shown in Table 15 , relaxing the fixed thresholds to Equation 37 yields consistent gains in overall accuracy ( + 0.98 +0.98 on gpt-4o-mini , + 1.15 +1.15 on gpt-4.1 ), with the largest improvement on the Open-Domain subset under gpt-4o-mini ( + 3.92 +3.92 ), which is the category most exposed to long-horizon drift. The same trend holds on LongMemEval - S, where PreCoMem (DT) lifts the overall score from 84.28 84.28 to 85.36 85.36 under gpt-4o-mini , with the largest gains on KU (knowledge update, + 1.62 +1.62 ) and SSP (single-session preference, + 1.95 +1.95 ); these are precisely the question types that require per-user calibration of how aggressively to update beliefs.

paragraphs.en: These results show that adaptive thresholding is an almost-free extension that further personalizes PreCoMem for users with different stability profiles. We keep the fixed-threshold setting as the default in the main paper for controllable comparison, but we consider adaptive thresholding a natural deployment-time configuration, especially in long-horizon and cross-user settings.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果表明，自适应阈值化几乎是一种零成本的扩展，能够为具有不同稳定性特征的用户进一步个性化 PreCoMem。 为了实现可控的比较，我们在正文中默认保留固定阈值设置，但我们认为自适应阈值化是一种自然的部署时配置，尤其是在长期和跨用户场景中。

paragraphs.en: DiMoBench (Dialogue Implicit Memory Drift Benchmark) is designed to isolate belief-drift adaptation under sparse and implicit cues. The released suite consists of five 350-turn two-speaker dialogues, each built around a distinct persona drawn from a different combination of Big-Five extremes and life stages; for clarity the exposition below focuses on one canonical persona, but every quantitative result on DiMoBench (the dynamics in Figure 4 (b) and the operator ablation in Figure 4 (c)) is averaged across the five personas to avoid a single-persona artifact; the human–judge agreement audit in Table 8 uses the canonical persona, whose per-type accuracies lie within 0.15 0.15 points of the five-persona means. Within each persona the user’s latent attitude toward a target topic remains stable in turns 1–200, gradually reverses in turns 201–210 via 3–4 implicit events, and is then reinforced with denser behavioral signals in turns 211–240 before entering a low-frequency maintenance stage in turns 241–350.
paragraphs.zh: DiMoBench（对话隐式记忆漂移基准）旨在稀疏且隐式的线索下隔离信念漂移适应问题。 发布的测试集由五段 350 轮双人对话组成，每段对话围绕一个独特的角色构建，该角色取自大五人格极端特质与人生阶段的不同组合；为清晰起见，下文的阐述聚焦于一个标准角色，但 DiMoBench 上的所有定量结果（图 4 (b) 中的动态表现和图 4 (c) 中的算子消融实验）均在五个角色上取平均，以避免单一角色造成的偏差；表 8 中的人工—评判一致性审计使用的是标准角色，其各类型准确率与五角色均值之间的差距在 0.15 分以内。 在每个角色内部，用户对目标话题的潜在态度在第 1–200 轮保持稳定，在第 201–210 轮通过 3–4 个隐式事件逐渐发生逆转，随后在第 211–240 轮以更密集的行为信号得到强化，最后在第 241–350 轮进入低频维持阶段。

paragraphs.en: To stress long-horizon robustness, DiMoBench injects confounders: every 30 turns we insert irrelevant chit-chat or hypothetical narration that shares surface keywords with the target topic, and we introduce multiple similar entity names to induce attribution ambiguity. Each persona contributes 200 QA pairs distributed across the dialogue (denser sampling near the change point and sparser in the long maintenance tail; 1,000 1{,}000 in total across the five personas), covering (i) current-state inference, (ii) history recall, (iii) change-point detection, and (iv) hypothesis vs. fact distinction. Importantly, questions avoid explicit sentiment keywords and instead require reasoning from behavioral cues (plans, actions, reactions), making drift detection and correction rely on implicit evidence chains rather than lexical matches.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验长程鲁棒性，DiMoBench 注入干扰因素：每 30 轮我们插入与目标话题共享表面关键词的无关闲聊或假设性叙述，并引入多个相似的实体名称以诱发归因歧义。 每个人设贡献 200 个问答对，分布在对话中（在变更点附近采样更密集，在漫长的维持阶段尾部采样更稀疏；五个人设共计 1{,}000 1{,}000 个问答对），涵盖（i）当前状态推断、（ii）历史回忆、（iii）变更点检测，以及（iv）假设与事实的区分。 重要的是，问题避免使用显式的情感关键词，而是要求从行为线索（计划、行动、反应）中进行推理，使漂移检测与纠正依赖于隐式证据链而非词汇匹配。

paragraphs.en: Existing long-horizon dialogue benchmarks predominantly evaluate the read path : whether a system can correctly retrieve and reason over a static conversational record (LoCoMo [ 28 ] ) or whether it can infer implicit personalization from accumulated preferences (PersonaMem - v2 [ 16 ] ). None of them explicitly stress-test the write path , i.e., whether a memory system can correctly decide when to maintain, update, or correct its stored beliefs under gradual, implicit drift. DiMoBench is designed to fill this gap along three axes that are absent from existing benchmarks simultaneously: (i) continuous non-stationarity , where the latent attitude reverses gradually over hundreds of turns without any explicit announcement; (ii) implicit behavioral cues , where the drift manifests only through activity choices, reactions to invitations, and hedging language rather than sentiment keywords; and (iii) adversarial retrieval interference , where five tagged interference types ( entity_confusable , keyword_trap , temporal_decoy , hypothetical_vs_fact , none ) systematically probe two stability–plasticity failure modes: old-memory pull and premature correction . This write-path orientation is what lets DiMoBench reveal the distinct contributions of MAINTAIN , PROFILE , and CORRECT in Section C.4 , which cannot be isolated on LoCoMo or PersonaMem - v2 alone.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的长程对话基准主要评估读取路径（read path）：即系统能否在静态对话记录上进行正确的检索与推理（LoCoMo [28]），或能否从累积的偏好中推断隐式个性化信息（PersonaMem-v2 [16]）。 它们都没有明确地对写入路径（write path）进行压力测试，即记忆系统能否在渐进、隐式的漂移下正确决定何时维持、更新或修正其存储的信念。 DiMoBench 旨在从现有基准无法同时具备的三个维度填补这一空白：(i) 持续非平稳性（continuous non-stationarity），即潜在态度在数百轮对话中逐渐反转且没有任何显式声明；(ii) 隐式行为线索（implicit behavioral cues），即漂移仅通过活动选择、对邀请的回应以及含糊其辞的语言来体现，而非情感关键词；以及 (iii) 对抗性检索干扰（adversarial retrieval interference），即五种带标签的干扰类型（entity_confusable、keyword_trap、temporal_decoy、hypothetical_vs_fact、none）系统性地探测两种稳定性–可塑性失败模式：旧记忆牵引（old-memory pull）和过早修正（premature correction）。 正是这种面向写入路径的设计，使 DiMoBench 能够在 C.4 节中揭示 MAINTAIN、PROFILE 和 CORRECT 的不同贡献，而这些贡献在仅使用 LoCoMo 或 PersonaMem-v2 时是无法分离出来的。

paragraphs.en: DiMoBench is constructed by a six-stage progressive pipeline with an explicit generator–verifier separation (GPT-4o for generation, Gemini-2.5-Pro for verification) to avoid self-reinforcing biases. Figure 9 visualizes the full pipeline as an end-to-end flow, and Table 16 summarizes the stages; details follow below.

paragraphs.en: Stage 1 (Persona). Each persona is characterized by one core emotional/behavioral slot (e.g., “attitude toward social activities”) with a well-defined initial state and target state, a set of Big-Five personality dimensions, a small social circle of 2–3 named characters (some deliberately confusable to enable interference evaluation), routine daily activities, and a psychologically plausible drift trigger.
paragraphs.zh: 第一阶段（角色设定）。 每个角色由一个核心情绪/行为槽位（例如“对社交活动的态度”）刻画，该槽位具有定义明确的初始状态和目标状态，还包括一组大五人格维度、一个由2–3个具名角色组成的小社交圈（其中一些刻意设计得容易混淆，以便进行干扰评估）、日常例行活动，以及一个在心理上合理的漂移触发因素。

sents.en: Stage 1 (Persona).
sents.zh: 第一阶段（角色设定）。

sents.en: Each persona is characterized by one core emotional/behavioral slot (e.g., “attitude toward social activities”) with a well-defined initial state and target state, a set of Big-Five personality dimensions, a small social circle of 2–3 named characters (some deliberately confusable to enable interference evaluation), routine daily activities, and a psychologically plausible drift trigger.
sents.zh: 每个角色由一个核心情绪/行为槽位（例如“对社交活动的态度”）刻画，该槽位具有定义明确的初始状态和目标状态，还包括一组大五人格维度、一个由2–3个具名角色组成的小社交圈（其中一些刻意设计得容易混淆，以便进行干扰评估）、日常例行活动，以及一个在心理上合理的漂移触发因素。

paragraphs.en: Stage 2 (Life skeleton). The 350-turn trajectory is organized into 35 sessions of 10 turns each. Sessions 1–20 (turns 1–200) establish baseline behavior; session 21 (turns 201–210) introduces the drift trigger via 3–4 implicit events; sessions 22–24 (turns 211–240) reinforce the new behavior with denser cues; sessions 25–35 (turns 241–350) form a low-frequency maintenance stage with monotonically reduced divergence from a steady post-drift baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段二（人生骨架）。 这条350轮的轨迹被组织为35个会话，每个会话10轮。 会话1–20（第1–200轮）建立基线行为；会话21（第201–210轮）通过3–4个隐式事件引入漂移触发；会话22–24（第211–240轮）以更密集的线索强化新行为；会话25–35（第241–350轮）构成一个低频维持阶段，其偏离相对于漂移后的稳定基线单调递减。

paragraphs.en: Stage 3 (Dialogue generation). Sessions are generated sequentially under cumulative context management. Generation rules enforce natural small talk and topic shifts, implicit expression through activity choices and hedging language, no meta-commentary (the user never says “I’ve changed”), and frequent temporal markers (“last weekend”, “this month”) for temporal reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段3（对话生成）。 会话在累积上下文管理下按顺序生成。 生成规则要求自然的闲聊和话题转换、通过活动选择和模糊措辞进行含蓄表达、不出现元评论（用户从不说“我已经改变了”），以及使用频繁的时间标记（如“上周末”“这个月”）以支持时间推理。

paragraphs.en: Stage 4 (QA generation). 200 QA pairs span all temporal phases (pre-change: 90; change-point: 10; post-change: 100). Each QA carries explicit evidence pointers ( D{session}:{turn} ), an interference tag, and a reasoning-type label.

paragraphs.en: Stage 5 (Consistency verification). Each QA is cross-validated by Gemini-2.5-Pro along six dimensions: (i) answer grounding (is the answer supported by cited evidence?), (ii) evidence completeness (are all relevant turns cited?), (iii) temporal consistency (does the answer reflect the correct phase?), (iv) entity accuracy , (v) interference validity (does the tag match the question?), and (vi) drift coherence (is the behavioral change gradual and plausible?). QA pairs marked REVISE are regenerated by GPT-4o using verifier feedback (max 3 rounds); pairs marked REJECT are discarded. We target an ≥ 95 % \geq\!95\% ACCEPT rate on the auto-verification pass.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 5（一致性验证）。 每个问答对由 Gemini-2.5-Pro 沿六个维度进行交叉验证：(i) 答案依据（答案是否有引用的证据支持？），(ii) 证据完整性（是否引用了所有相关轮次？），(iii) 时间一致性（答案是否反映了正确的阶段？），(iv) 实体准确性，(v) 干扰有效性（标签是否与问题匹配？），以及 (vi) 漂移连贯性（行为变化是否渐进且合理？）。 被标记为 REVISE 的问答对由 GPT-4o 根据验证器反馈重新生成（最多 3 轮）；被标记为 REJECT 的问答对被丢弃。 我们在自动验证环节中以不低于 95% \geq\!95\% 的 ACCEPT 率为目标。

paragraphs.en: Stage 6 (Human–machine review). Three graduate-level annotators with NLP research experience underwent a 2-hour calibration session covering implicit emotional expression, temporal reasoning, and entity disambiguation. All annotators independently label the same 20 QA pairs, and independent annotation proceeds only after inter-annotator agreement reaches κ ≥ 0.75 \kappa\!\geq\!0.75 (Cohen’s κ \kappa ). A 20% stratified sample (stratified by temporal phase, interference type, and QA category) receives full human review; in addition, one annotator per persona performs a full 350-turn dialogue-coherence assessment. Quality targets are answer correctness ≥ 95 % \geq\!95\% , dialogue naturalness ≥ 8.0 / 10 \geq\!8.0/10 , and drift subtlety ≥ 7.5 / 10 \geq\!7.5/10 .
paragraphs.zh: 阶段6（人机审查）。 三名具有自然语言处理研究经验的研究生水平标注者参加了一次为期2小时的校准培训，内容涵盖内隐情感表达、时序推理和实体消歧。 所有标注者独立标注相同的20个问答对，只有当标注者间一致性达到 κ ≥ 0.75 \kappa\!\geq\!0.75（Cohen's κ \kappa）后，才进行独立标注。 对20%的分层样本（按时间阶段、干扰类型和问答类别分层）进行完整人工审查；此外，每个人设由一名标注者执行完整的350轮对话连贯性评估。 质量目标为：答案正确率 ≥ 95 % \geq\!95\%，对话自然度 ≥ 8.0 / 10 \geq\!8.0/10，漂移隐蔽性 ≥ 7.5 / 10 \geq\!7.5/10。

paragraphs.en: To stress-test the system beyond DiMoBench’s 350-turn horizon and across more personas, we constructed DiMoBench - XL , a suite of five 1050-turn dialogues, each with three sequential implicit drifts. Following the DiMoBench pipeline in Section C.6 , we instantiate five user personas (each with a distinct demographic and dispositional profile, sampled to span both Big-Five extremes and different life stages); within each persona we keep five independent attributes (drink preference, exercise habit, home city, employment status, social style) and apply three drifts at turns { 280,580,870 } \{280,580,870\} , each shifting one or two attributes via 20 20 – 30 30 behavioral cues distributed across the surrounding session. Per persona we sample 20 evaluation QA pairs every 50 turns ( 420 420 pairs each, 2,100 2{,}100 in total), balanced across four reasoning types and five interference tags. The whole suite is verified by Gemini-2.5-Pro with the same six-criterion protocol as DiMoBench, achieving a 96.4 % 96.4\% average ACCEPT rate across personas (range 94.8 94.8 – 97.6 % 97.6\% ) after one revision round.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在 DiMoBench 的 350 轮时限之外、跨更多用户画像对系统进行压力测试，我们构建了 DiMoBench-XL，这是一个包含五段 1050 轮对话的测试集，每段对话包含三个连续的隐式漂移。 按照 C.6 节中 DiMoBench 的流程，我们实例化了五个用户画像（每个都具有独特的人口统计特征和性格特征档案，经采样覆盖大五人格的两个极端以及不同的人生阶段）；在每个画像内，我们保留五个独立属性（饮品偏好、锻炼习惯、所在城市、就业状态、社交风格），并在第 {280,580,870} 轮施加三次漂移，每次通过分布在附近会话中的 20–30 个行为线索来改变一到两个属性。 对每个画像，我们每 50 轮采样 20 个评估问答对（每个画像 420 对，总计 2,100 对），并在四种推理类型和五种干扰标签之间保持均衡。 整个测试集由 Gemini-2.5-Pro 按照 DiMoBench 相同的六项标准协议进行验证，经过一轮修订后，各画像的平均通过率达到 96.4%（范围为 94.8%–97.6%）。

N eff N_{\mathrm{eff}} enters its 25.8 25.8 – 28.5 28.5 plateau by turn 200 200 , dips by at most 1.1 1.1 points at a drift on this persona (at most 1.6 1.6 across the five personas), and recovers within ∼ \sim 50 turns to the same band. paragraphs.en: Table 18 aggregates QA accuracy across the five DiMoBench - XL personas in five time windows (means across the five personas). Across 1050 1050 turns and three drifts, Overall accuracy decays only 2.3 2.3 points (from 84.3 % 84.3\% to 82.0 % 82.0\% on average) and the average Top-10 retrieval confidence stays at or above 0.78 0.78 in every persona, confirming that long-horizon retention is gracefully degraded by confidence weighting rather than catastrophically collapsed; persona-level standard deviations stay below 1.0 1.0 accuracy point in every window.

paragraphs.en: A second concern is whether deprecated FACTs ( w t < 0.1 w_{t}\!<\!0.1 ) leak into Top- k k retrieval and silently bias the response. paragraphs.en: The write path acts only on the retrieved set 𝒞 t \mathcal{C}_{t} : if the belief that should be revised is not retrieved, the contradiction cannot be detected and CORRECT cannot fire in that turn. This section quantifies that dependence and then examines what the reliability coefficient ρ t \rho_{t} actually tracks.
paragraphs.zh: 写入路径仅作用于检索到的集合 𝒞 t \mathcal{C}_{t}：如果应当被修正的信念未被检索到，则矛盾无法被检测到，CORRECT 也就无法在该轮次中触发。 本节量化这种依赖关系，然后考察可靠性系数 ρ t \rho_{t} 究竟追踪的是什么。

sents.en: This section quantifies that dependence and then examines what the reliability coefficient ρ t \rho_{t} actually tracks.

paragraphs.en: We call an update-due event a point at which a stored belief must be revised for a later question to be answered correctly (one per evaluation question on DiMoBench and DiMoBench - XL, one per state transition with a pre-existing belief on AMemGym, and one per knowledge-update turn on LongMemEval - S KU), and we measure the Recall@10 of the belief due for update, i.e., how often it enters the write-path Top-10 at that event. Table 23 shows that recall covers most events (89–95%), leaving an explicit 5–11% blind spot, and that misses matter: question accuracy on events whose target was retrieved exceeds that on missed events by 16–22 points. Retrieval is favorable here because a contradictory utterance shares the attribute of the belief it contradicts with opposite polarity, so the target scores high on the semantic and lexical terms of Equation 1 . Decomposing all update-due events pooled over the four benchmarks, 89.3% succeed; the residual 10.7% splits into unrecovered retrieval misses (5.4%; a further 1.4% of events are missed at retrieval but corrected later), gate misses (3.1%; the target was retrieved but the turn was not routed to CORRECT ) and localization misses (2.2%; the turn was routed to CORRECT but the target was not decayed). Retrieval is thus the largest single source, with half of the failures (5.3 of the 10.7 points) sitting in gating and localization; on LongMemEval - S KU, where each update is stated once, retrieval misses dominate. A miss does not stall adaptation: the observation still enters the episodic cache and can form a hypothesis, and 20% of missed events (147 of 718) are corrected later by subsequent cues or hypothesis promotion.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将「更新到期事件」定义为：为使后续问题能被正确回答，某条已存储信念必须被修订的时间点（在 DiMoBench 和 DiMoBench - XL 上每个评估问题对应一次，在 AMemGym 上每个带有既有信念的状态转移对应一次，在 LongMemEval - S KU 上每个知识更新轮次对应一次），并且我们测量该待更新信念的 Recall@10，即它在该事件上进入写入路径 Top-10 的频率。 表 23 显示，召回覆盖了大多数事件（89–95%），留下 5–11% 的明确盲区，且漏检影响重大：在目标被检索到的事件上，问题准确率比在漏检事件上高出 16–22 个百分点。 检索在此处于有利位置，因为一条矛盾性话语与其所矛盾的信念共享同一属性但极性相反，因此目标在公式 1 的语义项和词法项上得分很高。 对四个基准上汇总的所有更新到期事件进行分解，89.3% 成功；剩余的 10.7% 分解为未恢复的检索漏检（5.4%；另有 1.4% 的事件在检索时被漏检但事后得到纠正）、门控漏检（3.1%；目标被检索到但该轮次未被路由到 CORRECT）以及定位漏检（2.2%；该轮次被路由到 CORRECT 但目标未被衰减）。 因此检索是最大的单一来源，一半的失败（10.7 个百分点中的 5.3 个）落在门控与定位环节；在 LongMemEval - S KU 上，由于每次更新仅被陈述一次，检索漏检占主导地位。 一次漏检并不会使适应停滞：该观察仍会进入情景缓存并可形成假设，且 20% 的漏检事件（718 个中的 147 个）会通过后续线索或假设晋升在事后得到纠正。
