sents.zh: 检索在此处于有利位置，因为一条矛盾性话语与其所矛盾的信念共享同一属性但极性相反，因此目标在公式 1 的语义项和词法项上得分很高。

sents.en: Decomposing all update-due events pooled over the four benchmarks, 89.3% succeed; the residual 10.7% splits into unrecovered retrieval misses (5.4%; a further 1.4% of events are missed at retrieval but corrected later), gate misses (3.1%; the target was retrieved but the turn was not routed to CORRECT ) and localization misses (2.2%; the turn was routed to CORRECT but the target was not decayed).
sents.zh: 对四个基准上汇总的所有更新到期事件进行分解，89.3% 成功；剩余的 10.7% 分解为未恢复的检索漏检（5.4%；另有 1.4% 的事件在检索时被漏检但事后得到纠正）、门控漏检（3.1%；目标被检索到但该轮次未被路由到 CORRECT）以及定位漏检（2.2%；该轮次被路由到 CORRECT 但目标未被衰减）。

sents.en: Retrieval is thus the largest single source, with half of the failures (5.3 of the 10.7 points) sitting in gating and localization; on LongMemEval - S KU, where each update is stated once, retrieval misses dominate.
sents.zh: 因此检索是最大的单一来源，一半的失败（10.7 个百分点中的 5.3 个）落在门控与定位环节；在 LongMemEval - S KU 上，由于每次更新仅被陈述一次，检索漏检占主导地位。

sents.en: A miss does not stall adaptation: the observation still enters the episodic cache and can form a hypothesis, and 20% of missed events (147 of 718) are corrected later by subsequent cues or hypothesis promotion.
sents.zh: 一次漏检并不会使适应停滞：该观察仍会进入情景缓存并可形成假设，且 20% 的漏检事件（718 个中的 147 个）会通过后续线索或假设晋升在事后得到纠正。

paragraphs.en: To separate association from causation we force the target belief into the Top-10 at every missed event (displacing the lowest-ranked item) and re-run the write path and the question. This closes only 26–32% of the hit–miss gap (last column of Table 23 ): forcing the hit raises accuracy on the affected questions by 4.5–6.5 points, while the rest of the gap reflects that missed events are intrinsically harder and that gating and localization can still fail once the target is retrieved.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将关联与因果区分开，我们在每次遗漏事件中都强制将目标信念置入 Top-10（替换排名最低的条目），并重新运行写入路径和问题。 这只能弥合 26–32% 的命中–遗漏差距（表 23 的最后一列）：强制命中使受影响问题的准确率提高 4.5–6.5 个百分点，而差距的其余部分反映了遗漏事件本质上更难，且即使目标已被检索到，门控和定位仍可能失败。

paragraphs.en: ρ t = 1 − H t \rho_{t}=1-H_{t} is the normalized concentration of the Top- K K retrieval scores. It does not judge whether an individual retrieved item is correct; it weights how far the surprisal computed from that recall can be trusted, and because it enters only multiplicatively it can make the gate more conservative but never more aggressive. Two cases illustrate the behavior. If several relevant memories are correctly retrieved with similar scores, ρ t \rho_{t} is lower and the update is dampened and deferred; no information is lost, since supporting evidence keeps accumulating through the hypothesis lifecycle and a genuine change is still committed after slightly more confirmation. If a wrong memory receives a very high score, ρ t \rho_{t} is high, but ρ t \rho_{t} is deliberately not the sole trigger: whether CORRECT fires still depends on d conf d_{\mathrm{conf}} , an NLI verifier run against the actual new utterance, and the change is a bounded, reversible soft decay that keeps provenance.
paragraphs.zh: ρ t = 1 − H t \rho_{t}=1-H_{t} 是 Top- K K 检索得分的归一化浓度。 它并不判断某条被检索到的条目是否正确；它衡量的是由该召回计算出的惊异值在多大程度上可信，并且由于它仅以乘法方式进入，它只能使门控更保守，而不会更激进。 两种情况可以说明其行为。 如果若干条相关记忆以相近的得分被正确检索，则 ρ t \rho_{t} 较低，更新会被抑制并延后；没有信息会丢失，因为支持证据会在假设生命周期中持续累积，而真正的变化在稍微多一点的确认后仍会被提交。 如果一条错误的记忆获得了非常高的得分，则 ρ t \rho_{t} 较高，但 ρ t \rho_{t} 被刻意设计为并非唯一触发条件：CORRECT 是否触发仍取决于 d conf d_{\mathrm{conf}} ，即针对实际新话语运行的 NLI 验证器，且该变化是一个有界的、可逆的软衰减，并保留来源信息。

paragraphs.en: To check that concentration is a usable proxy for evidence precision, we stratify the 2,829 gate events of the AMemGym runs (943 per seed) into quintiles of ρ t \rho_{t} and measure, per quintile, the precision of the retrieved set against the user’s current gold state, the recall of the belief due for update, the accuracy of the contradiction decision against 400 blind-annotated events (80 per quintile), the correctness of the resulting update, the share of CORRECT firings judged unwarranted (false- CORRECT ), and the accuracy of the next state-query probe on the touched attribute ( Table 24 ). Precision, contradiction accuracy, update correctness and downstream accuracy all rise monotonically from Q1 to Q5, and false corrections fall from 2.1% to 0.6% (only 5 of the 612 CORRECT firings were judged false overall), whereas recall is non-monotone and peaks in the middle quintiles. ρ t \rho_{t} therefore tracks evidence precision, as a precision weight on the prediction error should.
paragraphs.zh: 为了验证集中度可以作为证据精度的可用代理指标，我们将 AMemGym 运行的 2,829 个门控事件（每个种子 943 个）按 ρ t \rho_{t} 划分为五分位，并针对每个五分位测量以下指标：检索集合相对于用户当前黄金状态的精度、待更新信念的召回率、在 400 个盲标注事件（每个五分位 80 个）上矛盾判定的准确率、由此产生的更新的正确性、被判为无根据的 CORRECT 触发占比（假 CORRECT），以及在受影响属性上下一个状态查询探针的准确率（表 24）。 从 Q1 到 Q5，精度、矛盾准确率、更新正确性和下游准确率均单调上升，错误纠正从 2.1% 降至 0.6%（在全部 612 次 CORRECT 触发中仅有 5 次被判为错误），而召回率则非单调，在中间五分位达到峰值。因此 ρ t \rho_{t} 可以追踪证据精度，正如预测误差上的精度权重所应具备的特性。

paragraphs.en: A related concern is that genuine drift produces mixed retrieval evidence, old facts and new contradictions both in the Top- K K , which raises H t H_{t} and may delay CORRECT precisely when it is needed. We measure this on the 600 gold transitions of the AMemGym runs (20 profiles × \times 10 transitions × \times 3 seeds). In the first period after a change, a fresh belief node encoding the new state is created for 91.3% of the transitions and enters the answering Top-10 for 88.7%; the remaining 2.6% is a read-path ranking loss, since the new belief exists but does not enter the answering Top-10. A low ρ t \rho_{t} delays a warranted CORRECT in 14.2% of the transitions; of these delays 78.0% clear within one period and 94.0% within two, and only 2.8% persist to the end of the run. End-to-end, this bounded delay is what separates PreCoMem’s one-period recovery from the two periods of AWE and the 1.8–3.2 periods of the ablated variants ( Section C.1 ); removing the weighting altogether instead costs 16.76 points on LoCoMo (RR in Figure 4 (a)).
paragraphs.zh: 一个相关的担忧是，真实漂移会产生混合的检索证据，旧事实与新矛盾同时出现在 Top- K 中，这会抬高 H t ，并可能在最需要 CORRECT 时延迟其触发。 我们在 AMemGym 运行的 600 个黄金转换上对此进行测量（20 个档案 × 10 个转换 × 3 个随机种子）。 在变化发生后的第一个周期内，91.3% 的转换会创建一个编码新状态的全新信念节点，并使其进入回答的 Top-10；其余 2.6% 属于读取路径上的排序损失，即新信念已存在但未能进入回答的 Top-10。 较低的 ρ t 会在 14.2% 的转换中延迟本应触发的 CORRECT；在这些延迟中，78.0% 在一个周期内消除，94.0% 在两个周期内消除，只有 2.8% 持续到运行结束。 从端到端来看，这种有界的延迟正是将 PreCoMem 的一个周期恢复与 AWE 的两个周期以及消融变体的 1.8–3.2 个周期区分开来的关键（见 C.1 节）；而完全移除加权则会在 LoCoMo 上损失 16.76 分（见图 4 (a) 中的 RR）。

paragraphs.en: The same analysis on DiMoBench, which has gold change points, uses the ρ \rho -assessability criterion that a gold shift counts only when the outdated belief is in the Top- K K and S raw > θ high S_{\mathrm{raw}}>\theta_{\mathrm{high}} , so that ρ t = 1 \rho_{t}=1 would route the turn to CORRECT ; the delay d d is measured in turns ( Table 25 ). Delays are the exception and bounded on both tracks: 7.3% of the assessable shifts on DiMoBench and 14.8% on DiMoBench - XL are delayed, and 71.4% of the delays clear within one turn and 85.7% within two. DiMoBench - XL exceeds the base track, consistent with its three drifts over 1050 turns and denser decoys. Since DiMoBench counts turns whereas AMemGym counts periods, the two rates agree in magnitude without sharing a unit, which is why we report them per track.
paragraphs.zh: 对具有黄金变更点的 DiMoBench 进行同样的分析时，采用 ρ \rho 可评估性判据：只有当过时信念位于 Top- K K 且 S raw > θ high S_{\mathrm{raw}}>\theta_{\mathrm{high}} 时，黄金漂移才被计入，此时 ρ t = 1 \rho_{t}=1 会将该轮路由至 CORRECT；延迟 d d 以轮为单位测量（表 25）。 延迟是例外且在两条轨道上都有界：DiMoBench 上可评估漂移的 7.3% 和 DiMoBench - XL 上的 14.8% 出现延迟，其中 71.4% 的延迟在一轮内消除，85.7% 在两轮内消除。 DiMoBench - XL 超过了基础轨道，这与它在 1050 轮中包含三次漂移以及更密集的诱饵相一致。 由于 DiMoBench 以轮计数而 AMemGym 以周期计数，这两个比率在数量级上一致但不共享同一单位，因此我们按轨道分别报告它们。

paragraphs.en: A genuinely new topic differs from every stored belief, so its semantic-deviation term d sem d_{\mathrm{sem}} is high while d conf ≈ 0 d_{\mathrm{conf}}\approx 0 , and S raw S_{\mathrm{raw}} is driven up by novelty; even when all absolute similarities are small, one loosely related item normally dominates the Top- K K , so ρ t \rho_{t} stays moderate and S eff S_{\mathrm{eff}} lands in the PROFILE band. MAINTAIN would require an unsurprising cue with low d sem d_{\mathrm{sem}} , which a new topic is not. In cold-start probes on the AMemGym profiles, a first-time cue is written on an empty store 96.5% of the time (579 of 600 probes, each starting from a reset store); when the store is populated and the cue matches little, a usable belief forms within one period in 84.2% of cases and within two in 92.7% (600 new-topic probes), while only 5.6% of 180 distractor cues are written as hypotheses. A low match therefore costs at most a short confirmation delay. Section C.11 walks through an example.
paragraphs.zh: 一个真正全新的主题与所有已存储的信念都不同，因此其语义偏差项 d sem d_{\mathrm{sem}} 较高而 d conf ≈ 0 d_{\mathrm{conf}}\approx 0 ，并且 S raw S_{\mathrm{raw}} 因新颖性而被推高；即使所有绝对相似度都很小，通常也会有一个松散相关的条目主导 Top- K K ，因此 ρ t \rho_{t} 保持中等水平，而 S eff S_{\mathrm{eff}} 落在 PROFILE 区间内。 MAINTAIN 需要一个 d sem d_{\mathrm{sem}} 较低的不令人意外的线索，而新主题并非如此。 在对 AMemGym 配置的冷启动探测中，96.5% 的情况（600 次探测中的 579 次，每次都从重置后的存储开始）首次线索被写入空存储；当存储已有内容且线索几乎不匹配时，84.2% 的情况（600 次新主题探测）在一个周期内形成可用信念，两个周期内为 92.7%，而 180 条干扰线索中仅有 5.6% 被写为假设。 因此，低匹配最多只带来短暂的确认延迟。 附录 C.11 给出了一个示例的完整过程。

sents.en: A genuinely new topic differs from every stored belief, so its semantic-deviation term d sem d_{\mathrm{sem}} is high while d conf ≈ 0 d_{\mathrm{conf}}\approx 0 , and S raw S_{\mathrm{raw}} is driven up by novelty; even when all absolute similarities are small, one loosely related item normally dominates the Top- K K , so ρ t \rho_{t} stays moderate and S eff S_{\mathrm{eff}} lands in the PROFILE band.

sents.en: MAINTAIN would require an unsurprising cue with low d sem d_{\mathrm{sem}} , which a new topic is not.
sents.zh: MAINTAIN 需要一个 d sem d_{\mathrm{sem}} 较低的不令人意外的线索，而新主题并非如此。

sents.en: In cold-start probes on the AMemGym profiles, a first-time cue is written on an empty store 96.5% of the time (579 of 600 probes, each starting from a reset store); when the store is populated and the cue matches little, a usable belief forms within one period in 84.2% of cases and within two in 92.7% (600 new-topic probes), while only 5.6% of 180 distractor cues are written as hypotheses.
sents.zh: 在对 AMemGym 配置的冷启动探测中，96.5% 的情况（600 次探测中的 579 次，每次都从重置后的存储开始）首次线索被写入空存储；当存储已有内容且线索几乎不匹配时，84.2% 的情况（600 次新主题探测）在一个周期内形成可用信念，两个周期内为 92.7%，而 180 条干扰线索中仅有 5.6% 被写为假设。

sents.en: A low match therefore costs at most a short confirmation delay.
sents.zh: 因此，低匹配最多只带来短暂的确认延迟。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval latency measures only the cost of producing the retrieved evidence set 𝒞 t \mathcal{C}_{t} (memory read, scoring, and any re-ranking), and isolates the architectural cost of the memory system itself.

paragraphs.en: End-to-end (E2E) latency measures the full user-visible time from receiving a query u t u_{t} to emitting the final answer, including retrieval plus generation.

paragraphs.en: Efficiency via vectorized scoring: PreCoMem achieves a competitive P50 by leveraging a confidence-modulated hybrid scoring mechanism ( Equation 1 ). Rather than relying on computationally intensive generative re-ranking or iterative graph traversals, our approach efficiently aggregates semantic and lexical signals through parallelizable matrix operations. This design ensures that the computational overhead remains modest relative to pure vector retrieval, even as the complexity of the belief store increases.
paragraphs.zh: 通过向量化评分实现高效性：PreCoMem 借助置信度调制的混合评分机制（公式 1）取得了具有竞争力的 P50。 我们的方法不依赖计算密集型的生成式重排序或迭代式图遍历，而是通过可并行化的矩阵运算高效地聚合语义与词汇信号。 即使信念存储的复杂度增加，该设计仍能确保计算开销相对于纯向量检索保持在较低水平。

paragraphs.en: Stability via deterministic flow: A critical advantage of PreCoMem is its robustness against latency spikes. Unlike agentic architectures (e.g., A-Mem) that may trigger unpredictable, recursive reasoning loops to resolve ambiguities, PreCoMem employs a deterministic, non-recursive retrieval flow. This architectural choice constrains both the retrieval tail (P95: 3.86s) and the E2E tail (P95: 4.36s), ensuring consistent performance without the extreme delays (E2E P95 up to 7.68s for A-Mem) often observed in stochastic agentic systems.
paragraphs.zh: 通过确定性流程实现稳定性：PreCoMem 的一个关键优势是其对延迟尖峰的鲁棒性。 与可能触发不可预测的递归推理循环来解决歧义的智能体架构（如 A-Mem）不同，PreCoMem 采用确定性的、非递归的检索流程。 这一架构选择同时约束了检索尾部延迟（P95：3.86秒）和端到端尾部延迟（P95：4.36秒），确保了性能的一致性，避免了随机性智能体系统中常见的极端延迟（A-Mem 的端到端 P95 高达 7.68秒）。

paragraphs.en: Existing systems represent the importance of an incoming observation categorically . GAM [ 46 ] writes one compressed memo per session into an immutable page-store with no per-item weight; EverMemOS [ 10 ] validates each MemCell within a hard time interval [ t start , t end ] [t_{\mathrm{start}},t_{\mathrm{end}}] and treats it as expired once the interval closes; TiMem [ 21 ] encodes importance through its five-level temporal hierarchy and explicitly notes the absence of a storage-time forgetting mechanism; MemBox [ 38 ] stores all events inside a sealed topic box at uniform weight; O-Mem [ 40 ] updates persona slots via an LLM that selects one of three categorical actions ( Add / Ignore / Update ); Mem0 [ 2 ] commits ADD/UPDATE/DELETE/NOOP and physically removes contradicted memories on DELETE; and A-Mem [ 45 ] replaces an existing note with an LLM-rewritten note via Memory Evolution. None of these systems can defer commitment when evidence is ambiguous: a weak signal is either ignored or instantly written as a fact. PreCoMem’s continuous confidence weight w t ​ ( m ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] w_{t}(m)\!\in\![0,1] paired with the HYPOTHESIS waiting room lets weak cues accumulate evidence across turns and only graduate into FACT once support concentrates. The same mechanism preserves established traits: soft-decay correction ( Equation 10 ) reduces the influence of contradicted facts without erasing them, so a transient noise burst cannot remove a long-established trait the way a hard DELETE or overwrite would. This explains the LongMemEval - S gains on SSP (single-session preference), MS (multi-session aggregation), and KU (knowledge update) in Table 1 , where ambiguous and conflicting cues dominate the question pool and categorical commit decisions are exactly the wrong granularity.
paragraphs.zh: 现有系统以分类方式表示输入观测的重要性。 GAM [46] 在每个会话中向不可变页面存储写入一份压缩备忘录，且没有逐条权重；EverMemOS [10] 在硬性时间区间 [t_start, t_end] 内校验每个 MemCell，并在区间关闭后将其视为过期；TiMem [21] 通过五级时间层级编码重要性，并明确指出缺乏存储时遗忘机制；MemBox [38] 将所有事件以统一权重存入密封的主题盒中；O-Mem [40] 通过 LLM 从三种分类操作（添加/忽略/更新）中选择其一来更新人设槽位；Mem0 [2] 提交 ADD/UPDATE/DELETE/NOOP 操作，并在 DELETE 时物理删除被反驳的记忆；A-Mem [45] 则通过记忆演化用 LLM 重写的笔记替换现有笔记。 这些系统在证据模糊时都无法推迟提交：微弱信号要么被忽略，要么被立即当作事实写入。 PreCoMem 的连续置信度权重 w_t(m) ∈ [0, 1] 与 HYPOTHESIS 等待室相配合，使微弱线索能够跨轮次累积证据，只有当支持集中时才晋升为 FACT。 同一机制还能保护已确立的特征：软衰减修正（公式 10）在不抹除被反驳事实的情况下降低其影响力，因此短暂的噪声爆发无法像硬 DELETE 或覆写那样移除长期确立的特征。 这解释了表 1 中 SSP（单会话偏好）、MS（多会话聚合）和 KU（知识更新）上的 LongMemEval-S 提升，因为在这些问题池中模糊与冲突线索占主导地位，而分类式提交决策恰恰是错误的粒度。

paragraphs.en: Each baseline retrieval substrate carries a structural failure mode that PreCoMem sidesteps. GAM iterates a deep-research loop over its page-store, whose answer correctness is order- and budget-sensitive; EverMemOS issues dense+BM25 retrieval over Atomic Facts, fuses by RRF, and then runs a sufficiency-check loop that can leave cross-shard inconsistency between MemCells of the same scene; TiMem performs a two-stage hierarchical recall whose scope depends on a planner classifier; MemBox returns full topic boxes wholesale with no within-box reweighting; O-Mem aggregates three parallel channels (working / episodic / persona) by union, so irrelevant attribute hits dilute the context window; Mem0 falls back on a single dense-similarity threshold and discards deleted-but-relevant facts; and A-Mem performs pure cosine top- k k over linked atomic notes, where the fine granularity amplifies fragmentation noise. All of these substrates therefore require an explicit reranker, sufficiency loop, or planner to suppress incoherent reads. PreCoMem instead multiplies a tri-signal relevance score by the per-item confidence w t ​ ( m ) w_{t}(m) ( Equation 1 ), which acts as an implicit reranker at no extra LLM call: high-support items naturally rise to the Top- K K , deprecated items naturally sink, and the entropy-based reliability ρ t \rho_{t} ( Equation 3 ) further damps unreliable updates when the score mass is diffuse. This is what produces the bounded retrieval contamination in Table 20 and the bounded effective memory in Figure 5 (b,c), both of which scale to the 1050-turn DiMoBench - XL run without recourse to a maintenance loop.
paragraphs.zh: 每种基线检索载体都存在一种结构性的失败模式，而 PreCoMem 规避了这些模式。 GAM 在其页面存储上迭代深度研究循环，其答案正确性对顺序和预算敏感；EverMemOS 对原子事实执行稠密+BM25 检索，通过 RRF 融合，然后运行充分性检查循环，这可能使同一场景的 MemCell 之间留下跨分片的不一致性；TiMem 执行两阶段分层召回，其范围依赖于规划器分类器；MemBox 整体返回完整的主题盒子，且不做盒子内重加权；O-Mem 通过并集聚合三条并行通道（工作记忆/情景记忆/人格），因此无关的属性命中会稀释上下文窗口；Mem0 依赖单一的稠密相似度阈值并丢弃已删除但相关的事实；A-Mem 则对链接的原子笔记执行纯余弦 top-k 检索，其细粒度放大了碎片化噪声。 因此，所有这些载体都需要显式的重排序器、充分性循环或规划器来抑制不连贯的读取。 相反，PreCoMem 将三信号相关性分数乘以逐项置信度 w_t(m)（公式 1），这相当于一个无需额外 LLM 调用的隐式重排序器：高支持度的项自然上升到 Top-K，被弃用的项自然下沉，而基于熵的可靠性 ρ_t（公式 3）在分数质量分散时进一步抑制不可靠的更新。 这正是表 20 中有界的检索污染以及图 5 (b,c) 中有界的有效记忆的成因，二者均可扩展到 1050 轮的 DiMoBench-XL 运行，而无需借助维护循环。

sents.zh: 每种基线检索载体都存在一种结构性的失败模式，而 PreCoMem 规避了这些模式。

sents.en: GAM iterates a deep-research loop over its page-store, whose answer correctness is order- and budget-sensitive; EverMemOS issues dense+BM25 retrieval over Atomic Facts, fuses by RRF, and then runs a sufficiency-check loop that can leave cross-shard inconsistency between MemCells of the same scene; TiMem performs a two-stage hierarchical recall whose scope depends on a planner classifier; MemBox returns full topic boxes wholesale with no within-box reweighting; O-Mem aggregates three parallel channels (working / episodic / persona) by union, so irrelevant attribute hits dilute the context window; Mem0 falls back on a single dense-similarity threshold and discards deleted-but-relevant facts; and A-Mem performs pure cosine top- k k over linked atomic notes, where the fine granularity amplifies fragmentation noise.
sents.zh: GAM 在其页面存储上迭代深度研究循环，其答案正确性对顺序和预算敏感；EverMemOS 对原子事实执行稠密+BM25 检索，通过 RRF 融合，然后运行充分性检查循环，这可能使同一场景的 MemCell 之间留下跨分片的不一致性；TiMem 执行两阶段分层召回，其范围依赖于规划器分类器；MemBox 整体返回完整的主题盒子，且不做盒子内重加权；O-Mem 通过并集聚合三条并行通道（工作记忆/情景记忆/人格），因此无关的属性命中会稀释上下文窗口；Mem0 依赖单一的稠密相似度阈值并丢弃已删除但相关的事实；A-Mem 则对链接的原子笔记执行纯余弦 top-k 检索，其细粒度放大了碎片化噪声。

sents.en: All of these substrates therefore require an explicit reranker, sufficiency loop, or planner to suppress incoherent reads.
sents.zh: 因此，所有这些载体都需要显式的重排序器、充分性循环或规划器来抑制不连贯的读取。

sents.en: PreCoMem instead multiplies a tri-signal relevance score by the per-item confidence w t ​ ( m ) w_{t}(m) ( Equation 1 ), which acts as an implicit reranker at no extra LLM call: high-support items naturally rise to the Top- K K , deprecated items naturally sink, and the entropy-based reliability ρ t \rho_{t} ( Equation 3 ) further damps unreliable updates when the score mass is diffuse.
sents.zh: 相反，PreCoMem 将三信号相关性分数乘以逐项置信度 w_t(m)（公式 1），这相当于一个无需额外 LLM 调用的隐式重排序器：高支持度的项自然上升到 Top-K，被弃用的项自然下沉，而基于熵的可靠性 ρ_t（公式 3）在分数质量分散时进一步抑制不可靠的更新。

sents.en: This is what produces the bounded retrieval contamination in Table 20 and the bounded effective memory in Figure 5 (b,c), both of which scale to the 1050-turn DiMoBench - XL run without recourse to a maintenance loop.
sents.zh: 这正是表 20 中有界的检索污染以及图 5 (b,c) 中有界的有效记忆的成因，二者均可扩展到 1050 轮的 DiMoBench-XL 运行，而无需借助维护循环。

paragraphs.en: The two axes are complementary: Axis 1 controls what is committed so that the belief store stays faithful to the user’s core traits under noise, while Axis 2 controls what surfaces at read time so that the dialogue agent sees a coherent, currently-supported view. Existing baselines optimize one axis at a time (e.g., EverMemOS’s profile updates target Axis 1; GAM’s deep-research targets Axis 2) but lack a single mechanism that couples them. PreCoMem couples them through the same scalar confidence weight w t w_{t} , which is the structural reason behind the consistent improvements observed across the four main benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 这两条轴线是互补的：轴线1控制提交什么内容，使信念存储在噪声下仍忠实于用户的核心特质；轴线2控制读取时呈现什么内容，使对话智能体看到一个连贯且当前可支持的观点。 现有基线一次只优化一条轴线（例如，EverMemOS 的画像更新针对轴线1；GAM 的深度研究针对轴线2），但缺少将二者耦合起来的单一机制。 PreCoMem 通过同一个标量置信度权重 w t w_{t} 将二者耦合，这是在四个主要基准上观察到的一致提升背后的结构性原因。

paragraphs.en: To make the contents and interface of the Belief Store concrete, we describe how a belief item is serialized in practice and show an example snapshot from a DiMoBench run at turn 210, i.e., right after the change-point session. Each belief item m ∈ ℬ t m\in\mathcal{B}_{t} carries (i) a natural-language proposition c ⁡ ( m ) c(m) , (ii) a type label τ ⁡ ( m ) ∈ { FACT , HYPOTHESIS } \tau(m)\in\{\texttt{FACT},\texttt{HYPOTHESIS}\} , (iii) a confidence weight w t ​ ( m ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] w_{t}(m)\in[0,1] , (iv) a creation timestamp and last-updated turn, and (v) pointers into the episodic cache ℰ t \mathcal{E}_{t} for provenance. A minimal serialization is shown in Figure 10 .

paragraphs.en: Confidence weights w t ​ ( m ) w_{t}(m) and other metadata are not exposed to the response-generation LLM. They only modulate retrieval ranking through the confidence-weighted score in Equation 1 , so that high-confidence items surface near the top of 𝒞 t \mathcal{C}_{t} . The dialogue agent receives a plain-text prompt constructed from the Top- K K item contents { c ⁡ ( m ) } m ∈ 𝒞 t \{c(m)\}_{m\in\mathcal{C}_{t}} together with the relevant episodic-cache excerpts. This keeps generation-time inputs close to a standard retrieval-augmented prompt while still letting the memory system use confidences internally.
paragraphs.zh: 置信度权重 w t ( m ) 与其他元数据不会暴露给负责生成回复的大语言模型。 它们仅通过公式 1 中的置信度加权分数来调节检索排序，使高置信度的条目排在 𝒞 t 的顶部附近。 对话智能体接收由 Top- K 条目内容 { c ( m ) } m ∈ 𝒞 t 连同相关情景缓存摘录构建的纯文本提示。 这使得生成阶段的输入接近标准的检索增强提示，同时仍让记忆系统在内部使用置信度。

paragraphs.en: Because every belief carries explicit type, confidence, and source pointers, snapshots like Figure 10 can be dumped at any turn for inspection, regression testing, or qualitative error analysis, without re-executing the model. This also makes it straightforward to audit which episodic-cache turns support each currently-held belief, which we use for the end-to-end traces below.
paragraphs.zh: 由于每个信念都带有显式的类型、置信度和来源指针，因此可以在任意回合随时导出如图 10 所示的快照，用于检查、回归测试或定性错误分析，而无需重新执行模型。 这也使得审计哪些情景缓存回合支持当前持有的每个信念变得非常直接，我们在下文的端到端轨迹中使用了这一方法。

paragraphs.en: Reliability-adjusted surprisal. The retrieved set consists of strong pre-change evidence (social enthusiasm) and a single emerging change-point cue ( D21:1 ), none of which closely matches the new observation (skipped invitation; solo activity). The score mass is therefore spread over several items (higher entropy), making retrieval reliability ρ t \rho_{t} moderate. Contradiction signals are also non-decisive: “work’s been busy” can explain a single skip, so d conf d_{\mathrm{conf}} is non-zero but not saturated. Overall, x t x_{t} falls into the medium regime ( θ low < x t ≤ θ high \theta_{\mathrm{low}}<x_{t}\leq\theta_{\mathrm{high}} ).
paragraphs.zh: 可靠性调整的意外度。 检索到的集合由较强的变化前证据（社交热情）和单一的新显现的转折点线索（ D21:1 ）组成，其中没有任何一项与新观测（被跳过的邀约；独自活动） closely 匹配。 因此分数质量分散在若干条目上（熵较高），使得检索可靠性 ρ t \rho_{t} 处于中等水平。 矛盾信号也不具决定性：“工作最近很忙”可以解释单次跳过，因此 d conf d_{\mathrm{conf}} 非零但未饱和。 总体而言， x t x_{t} 落入中等区间（ θ low < x t ≤ θ high \theta_{\mathrm{low}}<x_{t}\leq\theta_{\mathrm{high}} ）。

paragraphs.en: Evolution: PROFILE . PreCoMem writes a low-confidence hypothesis capturing a possible shift, e.g., “Mike may be starting to reduce large gatherings and explore quiet solo activities,” and links it to D21:6 / D21:8--9 in the episodic cache. Crucially, PreCoMem does not immediately correct the long-standing high-confidence “social enthusiast” belief, avoiding premature overwrite from a single ambiguous event.
paragraphs.zh: 演化：PROFILE。 PreCoMem 会写入一条低置信度的假设，记录可能发生的转变，例如“Mike 可能开始减少大型聚会，并探索安静的独处活动”，并将其链接到情景缓存中的 D21:6 / D21:8--9。 关键在于，PreCoMem 不会立即纠正长期存在的高置信度“社交爱好者”信念，从而避免因单一模糊事件导致过早覆写。

paragraphs.en: (Read) QA query. Q: “Is Mike still as enthusiastic about gatherings as before?” A: “Seems to be declining …” Using the newly written hypothesis plus the concrete episode ( D21:6 skipped invitation; D21:8--9 solo cafe), PreCoMem answers with a trend-aware response (declining / becoming evasive) while remaining cautious about permanence. In later sessions, repeated consistent cues (e.g., D23:3 “declined most invitations”) reinforce and eventually promote this hypothesis.
paragraphs.zh: (读取) QA 查询。 问：「Mike 是否还像以前那样热衷于聚会？」答：「似乎在下降……」PreCoMem 利用新写入的假设加上具体情节（D21:6 跳过的邀请；D21:8--9 独自去咖啡馆），给出一个具有趋势感知的回答（下降 / 变得回避），同时对这种变化的持久性保持谨慎。 在后续会话中，反复出现的一致线索（例如 D23:3 「拒绝了大多数邀请」）会强化并最终提升该假设。

sents.en: Q: “Is Mike still as enthusiastic about gatherings as before?” A: “Seems to be declining …” Using the newly written hypothesis plus the concrete episode ( D21:6 skipped invitation; D21:8--9 solo cafe), PreCoMem answers with a trend-aware response (declining / becoming evasive) while remaining cautious about permanence.
sents.zh: 问：「Mike 是否还像以前那样热衷于聚会？」答：「似乎在下降……」PreCoMem 利用新写入的假设加上具体情节（D21:6 跳过的邀请；D21:8--9 独自去咖啡馆），给出一个具有趋势感知的回答（下降 / 变得回避），同时对这种变化的持久性保持谨慎。

sents.en: In later sessions, repeated consistent cues (e.g., D23:3 “declined most invitations”) reinforce and eventually promote this hypothesis.
sents.zh: 在后续会话中，反复出现的一致线索（例如 D23:3 「拒绝了大多数邀请」）会强化并最终提升该假设。

paragraphs.en: Evolution: CORRECT . PreCoMem applies soft decay ( Equation 10 ) to the contradicted belief(s) retrieved from ℬ t \mathcal{B}_{t} that encode the old stance (e.g., “weekends without gatherings are boring”), while leaving non-contradictory items largely unchanged. Because confidence weights directly modulate future retrieval ( Equation 1 ), this correction reduces the chance of “old-memory pull” when later queries contain temporal-decoy phrasing.
paragraphs.zh: 演化：正确。 PreCoMem 对从 ℬ t \mathcal{B}_{t} 中检索到的编码旧立场（例如，“没有聚会的周末很无聊”）的被反驳信念应用软衰减（公式10），同时使非矛盾项基本保持不变。 由于置信度权重直接调制未来的检索（公式1），这种修正降低了后续查询包含时间诱饵措辞时出现“旧记忆拉扯”的可能性。

paragraphs.en: (Read) QA query. Q: “Would Mike still say ‘I’d be bored without socializing’?” A: “No, being alone is actually more fulfilling now.” PreCoMem retrieves the recent, high-support solitude evidence ( D33:9 , D28:2 ) and answers accordingly, while older evidence like D1:8 is downweighted by correction and recency, making the response robust to the temporal decoy.

paragraphs.en: Figure 11 shows two cases in which the answer depends on how evidence was consolidated; a third, constructed case walks through a new topic entering the store.
paragraphs.zh: 图 11 展示了两种答案取决于证据如何被整合的情况；第三个构建的案例演示了一个新主题进入存储库的过程。

paragraphs.en: Figure 11 (left) illustrates this case. The user initially reports a credential (CET-6), which can tempt a retrieval-only system to over-trust a single strong signal and recommend overly advanced practice. PreCoMem instead consolidates evidence across sessions: repeated behavioral cues (e.g., failing to articulate at an English corner) and professional feedback (teacher assessment) lower confidence in an over-optimistic self-evaluation, while preserving the belief that the foundation is adequate. At query time, Memory Leveraging recalls these calibrated beliefs (rather than a single credential trace) to condition response generation, leading to a plan that targets fluency and practice rather than premature advanced content.
paragraphs.zh: 图11（左）展示了这种情况。 用户最初报告了一项资历（CET-6），这可能诱使仅检索的系统过度信任单一强信号，从而推荐过于高阶的练习。 PreCoMem 则改为跨会话整合证据：重复的行为线索（例如在英语角无法清晰表达）以及专业反馈（教师评估）降低了过度乐观自我评估的可信度，同时保留了基础尚可的信念。 在查询时，记忆利用（Memory Leveraging）会召回这些经过校准的信念（而非单一的资历记录）来约束回复生成，从而得到一个针对流利度与练习、而非过早进入高阶内容的计划。

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon career discussions often mix stable skills (proven experience) with tentative claims (currently learning) and difficulty signals (struggles with complex systems). PreCoMem uses its confidence-weighted belief store to separate what is established (e.g., Python/Flask) from what is still emerging (e.g., React “loading”) and what should be deferred (e.g., microservices architecture). This produces right-sized recommendations: it proposes a near-term path aligned with demonstrated capability, while explicitly marking a challenge zone for later progression.
paragraphs.zh: 长期职业讨论常常将稳定的技能（已验证的经验）、暂定的说法（正在学习）与困难信号（在复杂系统上感到吃力）混在一起。 PreCoMem 利用其置信度加权的信念存储，将已经确立的内容（例如 Python/Flask）、仍在形成的内容（例如 React「加载中」）以及应当延后处理的内容（例如微服务架构）区分开来。 这会产生规模适度的建议：它提出一条与已展示能力相符的近期路径，同时明确标注一个供后续进阶的挑战区域。

paragraphs.en: Suppose the store holds the user’s work and food profile but nothing about music, and the user says for the first time: “I signed up for guitar lessons and practiced for an hour last night.” No belief matches and the Top- K K items are only loosely related, so absolute scores are low but one still dominates, giving a moderate ρ t \rho_{t} and, by the mechanism described in Section C.8 , PROFILE . The Profile-Agent writes the hypothesis “the user may have taken up guitar” with w 0 < τ promote w_{0}<\tau_{\mathrm{promote}} , linked by provenance to that turn and retrieval-visible at once, so the agent can already answer cautiously. If guitar recurs, MAINTAIN reinforces the hypothesis until it crosses τ promote \tau_{\mathrm{promote}} and becomes a FACT ; otherwise it remains a low-confidence hypothesis that never outranks committed facts. A new topic therefore enters provisionally, is usable immediately, and is committed only after repeated support.
paragraphs.zh: 假设商店保存了用户的工作和饮食画像，但没有任何关于音乐的信息，用户第一次说：“我报名了吉他课，昨晚练了一个小时。”没有信念匹配，Top-K 条目只是松散相关，因此绝对分数较低但仍有一项占主导，给出中等的 \rho_{t}，并按照第 C.8 节描述的机制输出 PROFILE。 Profile-Agent 写入假设“用户可能开始学吉他了”，其权重 w_{0}<\tau_{\mathrm{promote}}，通过溯源链接到该轮对话并立即可被检索到，因此智能体已经可以谨慎地作答。 如果吉他话题反复出现，MAINTAIN 会强化该假设，直到其超过 \tau_{\mathrm{promote}} 并成为 FACT；否则它仍是一个低置信度假设，永远不会排在已确立事实之上。 因此，新话题以临时方式进入，可立即使用，并且只有在获得反复支持后才被确立。

paragraphs.en: Across these cases, PreCoMem’s leveraging–evolution loop links response quality to memory consolidation. Evidence recalled for the current answer is also used to update confidence through MAINTAIN / PROFILE / CORRECT ( Section 2.4 ), so future retrieval and recommendations reflect accumulated support, implicit verification, and soft correction under contradiction.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些案例中，PreCoMem 的利用–演化循环将响应质量与记忆巩固联系在一起。 为当前回答召回的证据还会通过 MAINTAIN / PROFILE / CORRECT（第 2.4 节）用于更新置信度，从而使未来的检索与推荐能够反映累积的支持、隐式验证以及矛盾下的软性修正。
